answer_text:
A Day Labourer
A fellow working on 'no work no pay' basis is normally a day labourer. He is not salaried though not honorary as well. He usually does the work of a farmer massively. He sometimes is engaged in masonry. He becomes a rickshaw puller, a railway porter and a temporary hawker to some extent. He generally has no fixed job. Now he is a stone breaker and then a soil cutter. In the markets of city areas some minor boys keep a basket with them and help the buyers carry their heavy load of shopping to their residence (বাসস্থান). They are also day labourers leading a miserable condition. In our country, a day labourer is not well paid. He works from sunrise to sunset and even late night. But he does not get expected remuneration (পারিশ্রমিক) from their owners. He is sun burnt with a mirth of having due wages. He is drenched with torrents like a storm crow. He shivers in the pinching cold to drag his hard life forward. Of course his joys know no bounds when he earns more. Then he shops with his basket full and returns to his shabby cottage where his diseased wife and some naked or half naked children wait for having some food. But the case is reverse when he goes on without any work. He wears a gloomy (বিষণ্ণ) appearance visualising the famished (না খেয়ে থাকা) mouths of his family. Then he is between two fires what to do for his family members awaiting food with rictus. The rigorous condition of our day labourers ought to be upgraded with the all out effort of both Govt and commoners.

To : sophi@yahoo.com
Subject : Pen-friend proposal
Dear Sophia,
I have got your name and address from the advertisement that came out in 'The Telegraph' dated 3rd March 2016. You have wanted Bangladeshi pen-friend interested in travelling and reading comics. This advertisement has drawn my attention as I am also interested in these two things. Of course, it is not possible to travel everywhere in the world but we can have pen-friends all over the world, collect news from them and be intimate to them. Now let me give some details about myself and my family background. I read in class X in Holy Cross School, Dhaka. My favourite hobby is reading comics. My father is a teacher. But, I think, you respect this noble profession. However, I am eager to have a sketch of your family and yourself by return of post. Anticipating a long-drawn and pleasant friendship.
I remain,
Yours sincerely
Nila

answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

answer_text:
Traffic Jam
Traffic jam means blockade of vehicles on roads and streets. It is a problem of urban areas. There are a number of reasons of traffic jam. Unlicensed and unauthorised rickshaws are the main causes of traffic jam. Violating (অমান্য করে) traffic rules and regulations, illegal parking of vehicles on roads also causes traffic jam. Again, narrow roads and frequent digging for development work, cause traffic jam. Building materials piled on roads cause traffic jam too. Whatever the causes of traffic jam may be, it is a great threat of urban people. In our daily activities, we cannot become fast and punctual because traffic jam kills our valuable time. Office going people, school going children and dying patients are also a victim to traffic jam. So, it is our bounden responsibility to solve this problem. But there is no fixed way to solve this problem. It requires united action to solve this problem. Shops and markets should be removed from the roadsides. In some places, government should build fly-over and people should be made aware of the traffic rules and regulations. We should not cross the roads in an indisciplined (বিশৃঙ্খল) way. All these measures will help us to remove the traffic jam.

Dear Sumona,

Your loving friend,
Arifa

answer_text:
Recent Floods in Bangladesh
Flood is a natural calamity. Almost every year it occurs in Bangladesh. Then our miseries know no bounds. It causes untold sufferings to lives. Lives are lost also, valuable riches and resources are destroyed, crops are damaged, domestic animals are washed away, trees and plants are uprooted, roads and high ways are damaged. In fact, flood causes indescribable loss to lives and properties. Now a question can be raised here why flood occurs in our country. In fact, Bangladesh is a low lying country. Besides, environment pollution severely occurs here. On the contrary, our neighbouring country India opens Farakka barage during the rainy season and flood water enters in our country. However, in 2004 flood occurred in Bangladesh. Almost every district went under water. Then human miseries knew no bounds. Relief materials were provided to the flood affected people but those were very much scanty. Besides, some relief materials were also stolen. In 2007 flood also occurred in our country. This flood also caused untold miseries to the affected people. But people were not deprived of relief goods and materials. Because of the fact that there is no political government at that time, the caretaker government strictly distributed relief materials among the affected people. No mismanagement and misappropriation of relief goods has not been heard. The affected people were also heavily pleased by having sufficient relief goods. It's really a matter of great credit. This government has also taken decision to provide the flood affected people with permanent solution, that is, those who are affected by flood are supposed to be rehabilitated. It's a good decision. However, as flood occurs in our country, precautionary steps should be taken to minimise losses caused by it. Otherwise hopes and aspirations will be shattered by the rocks of reality.

answer_text:
Tree Plantation/ Importance of Trees
Tree plantation means planting more trees and plants. The purpose of tree plantation is to save the endangered (বিপদগ্রস্ত করা) environment and to beautify our life. Tree plantation is very important because it serves many useful purposes. We get flowers, fruits, fuel and timber from trees. Trees make air fresh and improve the environment. They save us from natural calamities like drought, storms, floods, etc. They increase the beauty of nature. They give us oxygen and take up carbon dioxide and thus maintain ecological (বাস্তুসংস্থানগত) balance. In absence of trees, the country will turn into a desert. So trees are a valuable asset for our existence. Among the seasons, rainy season is the best time for tree plantation. We can plant trees around our dwelling places and in open places. Moreover, trees can be planted by the roads, rivers, canals and playing fields. Awareness should be raised and campaign should be launched to motivate people for tree plantation. Thus we can make the tree plantation programme a success.
[Words : 164]

25 February 2025
The Headmaster
Rangpur Zilla School
Subject : Application for increasing common room facilities.
Sir,
I have the honour to invite your kind attention to the fact that our school common room does not have modern facilities. In proportion to the number of students indoor facilities are quite insufficient. Many of us have to keep idle in gossiping during the off period or leisure time. We also need some more playing instruments. May I, therefore, pray and hope that your honour would be kind enough to provide us more common room facilities and oblige thereby.
Yours obediently
Labib

answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

answer_text:
The uses and abuses of Mobile Phone
Mobile phone refers to a telephone that does not have wires. It works by radio. One can carry it with oneself and use it anywhere. It is a recent scientific invention. It has created coruscation (আলোড়ন) all over the world. It is of great use to us. Besides communication with the people in distant places one can send message, know time-table, do calculation, play games and sports, hear songs and music, take snaps, be familiar with global culture by browsing internet with the help of mobile phone. And so its popularity is increasing day by day. One can communicate with one's near and dear persons in distant place in the twinkling of an eye by using mobile phone. It saves one's valuable time, energy and also money. One need not go to distant places to meet one's favourite persons for the use of mobile phone. With its golden touch, the countries of the world are like families in a village. But the mobile phone has still some drawbacks (খারাপ দিক) in disguise. Though its price is gradually decreasing per minute bill is not lessening. And so all cannot buy it. Scientists have recently discovered that mobile phone can cause cancer to the users. Besides, those who are terrorists use it at random and commit terrorist activities at large. Nevertheless, the importance of mobile phone in quick communication is very great.
question_text: Write a paragraph on 'The Uses and Abuses of Mobile Phone'.

answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.
question_text: Write a composition about 'Duties of Students'.

answer_text:
Our School Library
The word library is taken from the Latin word 'libre' which means a book. So we can say that a library is nothing but a collection of books. A school library means a house in the school where books are kept for the students as well as teachers. Our school has a library which is very spacious (wek vj). It is furnished with all modern facilities. Here almirahs are arranged in rows and tables are placed in the middle. Books are arranged in Dewey decimal system. Books including textbook, reference book and literary works are available here. Our school library also provides facilities including newspaper reading, organising debate (বিতর্ক), etc. Students can prepare their lessons as well as can take notes in the library. Even they are allowed to borrow books from the library by showing their library cards. In our library there are computers with internet facilities so that students can update themselves with the rest of the world. A school library is a must for spreading knowledge. It displays the rich store of knowledge. With the help of a library students can gather knowledge for building their better future.

answer_text:
My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most
All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football more than all other games. The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side. The game is generally played for ninety minutes. In the field the referee is the supreme authority to conduct the game. His decision is final. Two lines men assist him to run the game smoothly and properly. During the play no player except the goalkeeper can touch the ball with hands. No player in the game can make any foul, In case of making any foul the referee can send any player off the field. The victory goes to the team that can score more goals than the other. The game of football teaches us the principle of obedience to rules. It fosters the spirit of love, discipline and co-operation among the players. It develops team spirit and sportsmanship in the players. There is nothing which is an unmixed blessing. Too much involvement in the game often makes students apathetic towards their studies. Rivalry in the play often leads to quarrell among the supporters in the gallery and spoils the thrill and joy of the game. Sometimes it goes to touch extent that the whole ground turns into a battle field. But inspite of having some negative sides, football is the most popular and exciting game in the world.

The Person I Like Most/ My Favourite Personality (আমার প্রিয় ব্যক্তিত্ব)
I have met many men in my life. Some of them are great, some mediocre while others are ordinary. Of all men I have met I consider Abdur Rouf to be the most unforgettable character. He is my cousin and senior to me by five years. He is 25 years old and still a student. He is of fair complexion, well-built and tall for his age. He is a man of superb personality (ব্যক্তিত্ব). He helps us in every possible ways. I like him more for his fellow-feeling attitude. He is an example of humanitarian service. He is honest, truthful, straightforward (স্পষ্টবাদী) and outspoken but at the same time he is polite and humble. He points out other men's errors in a most gentle and pleasing way, so that nobody is displeased with him. He is fully aware of those people who have no moral stamina, no spirit of self-abnegation, no love for honesty and integrity. I have never met such a person as Rouf Bhai who possesses qualities like him. For this reason, I like him most.

answer_text:
Corruption is a Curse
Corruption is one of the social crimes that is considered to be an obstacle to progress. Hence, it is considered as a curse for a nation. Corruption means dishonest, illegal or immoral behaviour specially from someone who is in power. Corruption may originate from unsolved problems, unfinished works, vicious politics, weak administration and many other related or relevant things. The police department, education department, health department etc are the most corrupt sectors. Even the judicial department of the country which is an independent body is not free from corruption. The foreigners are always against the corruption of the country. It affects our people very much. The ultimate sufferings for corruptions go to the common people who are born to suffer and to be deprived of their legal rights, dues and so on. On the other hand, no corrupt person is hanged so far. The law machine is too slow to grind and punish the corrupt persons. To uproot this condition, we have to spread the light of true education.

answer_text:
50 Kazalshah, Sylhet-3100
10 March 2025
My dear Salam,
I am very sorry that you have not written to me for quite a while. It is not at all proper for a friend like you. But I got your news yesterday from your mother's letter. Aunt wrote that you smoke a lot of cigarettes. From her letter I came to know that you become a chain smoker. But my friend! You must know the dangers of smoking. So, why are you taking such a harmful thing? Do you forget that? Look, I tell you— Smoking does a lot of harm. A single puff of cigarette smoke contains 15 billion particles of substances which are very dangerous for health. The most harmful substance in cigarette smoke is nicotine, Methyl, Alcohol, Carbon monoxide, Formaldehyde, Arsenic, Benzopyrene and several other acids. Nicotine contracts the blood vessels and causes blood pressure leading to heart attack. Benzopyrene, arsenic and tobacco cause cancer. The bad effect of smoking leads to chronic bronchitis. Excessive smoking may lead a person to premature death. Such are the fatal effects of smoking. I suggest you to give up smoking just now and never to indulge in such dangerous habit again. Do give up smoking, if you love yourself. I am well. Hope this finds you quite hale and hearty.
Your loving friend,
Nasim

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Tree Plantation".
answer_text:
Tree Plantation/ Importance of Trees
Tree plantation means planting more trees and plants. The purpose of tree plantation is to save the endangered (বিপদগ্রস্ত করা) environment and to beautify our life. Tree plantation is very important because it serves many useful purposes. We get flowers, fruits, fuel and timber from trees. Trees make air fresh and improve the environment. They save us from natural calamities like drought, storms, floods, etc. They increase the beauty of nature. They give us oxygen and take up carbon dioxide and thus maintain ecological (বাস্তুসংস্থানগত) balance. In absence of trees, the country will turn into a desert. So trees are a valuable asset for our existence. Among the seasons, rainy season is the best time for tree plantation. We can plant trees around our dwelling places and in open places. Moreover, trees can be planted by the roads, rivers, canals and playing fields. Awareness should be raised and campaign should be launched to motivate people for tree plantation. Thus we can make the tree plantation programme a success.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Hobby".
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

To : johan@gmail.com
Subject : Wishing you "Happy Birthday"
Dear Johan,
First I would like to wish you happy birthday. May this very day bring you much more happy moments. It is also a tragedy for me to wish you without getting in touch physically. Yours ever,
Nahin

question_text: Write a composition on "Students and social services".
answer_text:
Students and Social Service
As students are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should render social services during leisure or long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can organize social service squads in their respective institutions to work in different areas. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot in removing illiteracy by educating the people in a proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, rules of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern scientific methods of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. In critical positions of the country, students must lead the country. As the students can nurse the wounded in the field of war, they can save life of many soldiers. Bangladesh faces natural calamities every year. During these disasters, the students can help the distressed people. Students must keep themselves ready to sacrifice their supreme pleasure at the time of danger. Then and only then he or she will be regarded as the crown of the deprived people because, they are the selfless sections of the society. Their services are regarded as noble deeds. So, they must take active part in these noble deeds.

question_text: Imagine, you are Nafis/Nafisa of College Road, Rangpur and recently you have visited your friend Nabila's house at Asian Highway, Chattogram. You have been very much charmed by the worm hospitality of your friend. Now write a letter to your friend thanking her for her hospitality.
answer_text:
College Road, Rajshahi
18 March 2025
Dear Nabila,
I reached home safely (নিরাপদ) yesterday evening, as apparently I had no trouble on my way home. I shall never forget the last few days I spent in your midst. How much care with all the warmth of your heart you all took of me! How solicitous (উৎকণ্ঠিত) and affectionate your parents were! It will be an act of ingratitude (অকৃতজ্ঞতা) on my part if I do not mention the name of your youngest brother, Nafis. Didn't you see how ready he always was for me? I deem, I was the pivot and attraction (আকর্ষণ), for your whole family revolved round me in those few days. How do I forget the recollection (স্মৃতি) of those days I was with you? The memory of my short stay will remain ever fresh in me. Allow me, my dear friend, to convey my heartful thanks to you all for your friendly hospitality (আতিথেয়তা). It is really uncommon nowadays. With best regards to your parents and love to the juniors especially my best wishes for brother Arif.
Yours ever,
Nafisa

question_text: Now, write a paragraph on Traffic Jam'.
answer_text:
Traffic Jam
Traffic jam means blockade of vehicles on roads and streets. It is a problem of urban areas. There are a number of reasons of traffic jam. Unlicensed and unauthorised rickshaws are the main causes of traffic jam. Violating (অমান্য করে) traffic rules and regulations, illegal parking of vehicles on roads also causes traffic jam. Again, narrow roads and frequent digging for development work, cause traffic jam. Building materials piled on roads cause traffic jam too. Whatever the causes of traffic jam may be, it is a great threat of urban people. In our daily activities, we cannot become fast and punctual because traffic jam kills our valuable time. Office going people, school going children and dying patients are also a victim to traffic jam. So, it is our bounden responsibility to solve this problem. But there is no fixed way to solve this problem. It requires united action to solve this problem. Shops and markets should be removed from the roadsides. In some places, government should build fly-over and people should be made aware of the traffic rules and regulations. We should not cross the roads in an indisciplined (বিশৃঙ্খল) way. All these measures will help us to remove the traffic jam.

question_text: Suppose, you are the students of a renowned school in the city. Your library is not rich in facilities. Write an application to your Headmaster requesting him to increase the library facilities.
answer_text:
11 June 2025
The Headmaster
City Model School, Khulna
Subject : Request for enhancing library facilities.
Sir,
With due honour I beg to state that we, the students of your school, have been suffering greatly for want of necessary books in the library. question_text: Write a composition on 'Importance of Reading Newspaper'.
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

Dear Bindu,

Yours
Shishir

question_text: Imagine you are Sumon/Sumona of 177, Broad Lane, Chattogram. Recently you have gone to a study tour from your school. Now, write a letter to your friend Adib/Adiba who lives at 8/9, Creative Road, Kadirganj, Rajshahi, telling him/her about the tour. Use the following clues. — date of the tour — place of the tour — mode of transport — things you have seen and enjoyed — knowledge gained
answer_text:
177, Broad Lane, Chattogram
30 March 2025
Dear Adib,
How are you and your family members? Hope all are well and hearty by the grace of the Almighty. Today I am writing to you to share a very interesting experience (খুব মজার অভিজ্ঞতা) that I have recently experienced. Actually, I am talking about the recent study tour organised by our school authority. We went to the study tour on the 28th instant of this month. The spot selected for the tour was Cox's Bazar Sea shore (সমুদ্র সৈকত). We hired two luxurious buses for transport. Our journey started at 8 in the morning. Some of our teachers including our class teacher accompanied us in the tour. We took some dry food prepared for the tour. We reached Cox's Bazar about two hours later. Reaching at the sea shore we got astonished. Specially I was so wondered (বিস্মিত হওয়া) as it was my first visit to the sea beach. We have seen a lot of people who gathered there in many groups. Some were bathing in the blue water and some were roaming to and fro with a joyous mood. After roaming (ঘোরাফেরা করা) for about a hour, we were asked to take a snap. Then we took a bath in the sea water. Our teachers told us not go so far in the water. After that our teachers decided to have lunch. We were taken to a hotel named 'Hotel Sea Girls' for lunch. It was really an aristocratic (অভিজাত) one. We enjoyed various sea fishes there. After lunch we took some rest and at the late afternoon we again went to the sea beach to enjoy the sunset scene. It was really a great wonder for us to see the sun setting into the water. The sun seemed to be diving into the sea. After that we went back to our bus and started our return journey. At 9.30 pm we reached Chattogram and returned home soon. It was really a memorable event (স্মরণীয় ঘটনা) in my life. No more today. Hope you will write me soon.
Yours ever,
Sumon

question_text: Write a paragraph on 'A Tea Stall'.
answer_text:
A Tea Stall (চায়ের দোকান)
A tea stall is an ever-present and essential part of daily life. This humble roadside establishment is where people gather to catch up with friends, engage in discussions, and take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The tea stall is typically a simple structure, consisting of a few wooden benches or plastic chairs, a small counter, and a large saucepan/cauldron of boiling water and a saucepan of milk for making tea. Customers can enjoy a hot cup of tea with a variety of snacks like biscuits, samosas, or singaras. The tea stall is a great equalizer, where people from all avenues of life come together to share a moment of relaxation. It is not uncommon to see students, office workers, shopkeepers, and even rickshaw pullers taking a break at the tea stall. The atmosphere is usually lively, with the sound of clinking glasses and chatter filling the air. In the evening, tea stalls transform into social hubs, where people gather to discuss politics, sports, and current affairs. A tea stall is not just a place to drink tea, it is a cultural phenomenon that reflects the warmth and hospitality of the people of our country. For many, a tea stall is a daily ritual, a place to unwind, and a respite from the chaos of the outside world. Whether you are a local or a tourist, a visit to a tea stall is a must-do experience that will leave you with a newfound appreciation for the simple pleasures of life.

question_text: Write a composition on 'Your Aim in Life' in about 250 words.
answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

question_text: Now, write a paragraph in 150 words on 'The life of a rickshaw puller'.
answer_text:
The Life of a Rickshaw Puller
A rickshaw puller is one who pulls rickshaw to take passengers to their destinations (গন্তব্য). He is a poor day labourer. In fact, finding no other means a man pulls rickshaw to earn his livelihood. Most often a rickshaw puller does not have his own rickshaw. He hires a rickshaw from a rickshaw owner on daily basis. Pulling a rickshaw is no doubt, a toilsome work. Even he has to pull rickshaw in rain or sun. Because, if he stops pulling rickshaw someday, he along with his family has to starve. A rickshaw puller pulls his rickshaw from dawn to dusk. Even if he feels out of sorts, he has to come out with his rickshaw to earn his livelihood. Moreover, sometimes he receives misbehaviour (দুর্ব্যবহার) from the passengers. Usually a rickshaw puller earns tk. 200 to 300 a day from which he has to pay the rent of the rickshaw to the rickshaw owner. If he earns too little someday for some reasons, he doesn't have anything left after paying the rent of the rickshaw. If his rickshaw breaks down for having an accident on roads, his miseries are beyond description. We should behave with him nicely. On a whole, a rickshaw puller leads his daily life in great difficulty.

question_text: Now, write a composition on "Duties of a Student".
answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

question_text: Imagine, you paid a visit to a book fair. Write a paragraph in about 150 words answering the following question.
answer_text:
My Visit to a Book Fair
A book fair is a special kind of fair where various kinds of books are displayed and sold. It gives an opportunity to buy different types of books at the same place. Recently I have visited a book fair at the Bangla Academy premises (চত্বর). Actually, it is an annual function and Bangla Academy authorities arrange the fair in memory of the language martyrs. It is termed "Amor Ekushey Boi Mela." When I entered the mela premises, I was really pleased at the calm and quiet environment. Though it was brimming (কানায় কানায় পূর্ণ) with people, there was no chaotic situation (বিশৃঙ্খল অবস্থা). I saw book lovers humming in the stalls without any trouble. I bought some books of varied interests. According to my list I collected some valuable books without any hazard. The decoration of the premises also pleased me very much. I was really fortunate as I met some eminent (প্রখ্যাত) writers of our country and I took autographs from them. Actually, I was really pleased at the fair and I hope it will uphold our culture in the arena of world literature (বিশ্ব সাহিত্য).

question_text: Suppose, you are Abir. You have a pen-friend named Zim who lives in Australia. He wants to know about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh. Now, write a letter to him about it.
answer_text:
22/A West Dhanmondi
Dhaka
11 October 2025
Dear Zim,
I hope you're doing well! I'm excited to tell you about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh, which has made a huge impact on our society. The movement initially began with students rallying for merit-based opportunities. They wanted to end the unfair quota system, which often limited opportunities for qualified students by reserving a large portion of jobs and university seats for specific groups. As this student-led protest grew, people from all walks of life began to join, seeing it as a stand against systemic discrimination and inequality. Over time, the movement evolved from focusing solely on quota reforms to challenging the government's authoritarian actions. The protests became a call for a more democratic and fair system, with the movement finally demanding that the fascist government step down. In the end, it wasn't just about students' rights but about justice and equality for all. The unity between students and the general public showed the strength of a united front against discrimination. Let me know if you want to hear more details!
Best wishes,
Abir

question_text: A rickshaw puller is a very familiar figure in our country. He plays a great role in our communication system. But he leads a very miserable life for financial problem. Now, write a paragraph in 150 words on "The life of a rickshaw puller".
answer_text:
The Life of a Rickshaw Puller
A rickshaw puller is one who pulls rickshaw to take passengers to their destinations (গন্তব্য). He is a poor day labourer. In fact, finding no other means a man pulls rickshaw to earn his livelihood. Most often a rickshaw puller does not have his own rickshaw. He hires a rickshaw from a rickshaw owner on daily basis. Pulling a rickshaw is no doubt, a toilsome work. Even he has to pull rickshaw in rain or sun. Because, if he stops pulling rickshaw someday, he along with his family has to starve. A rickshaw puller pulls his rickshaw from dawn to dusk. Even if he feels out of sorts, he has to come out with his rickshaw to earn his livelihood. Moreover, sometimes he receives misbehaviour (দুর্ব্যবহার) from the passengers. Usually a rickshaw puller earns tk. 200 to 300 a day from which he has to pay the rent of the rickshaw to the rickshaw owner. If he earns too little someday for some reasons, he doesn't have anything left after paying the rent of the rickshaw. If his rickshaw breaks down for having an accident on roads, his miseries are beyond description. We should behave with him nicely. On a whole, a rickshaw puller leads his daily life in great difficulty.

question_text: Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Every season has its own special aspects. You have a great attraction for one of the seasons. Now, write a composition on "The season you like most." (250 words)
answer_text:
The Season I Like Most/Best (The Spring)
Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Each season has its own features. Of the six seasons of Bangla year, I love the spring most. It is the king of seasons. The spring is one of the most delightful seasons in Bangladesh. It is the season of rebirth, rejuvenation and renewal. It starts in the month of Falgun (February/March) and lasts until Baishakh (April). The weather in spring is simply magical. The bitter cold of winter gradually fades away, and the cool breeze brings a pleasant feeling all around. There is no heavy rainfall, no dark cloud, or no scorching heat of summer. The bright sunshine and blue skies enhance the beauty of nature. The spring comes with the message of hope and enjoyment. The trees and plants put on new leaves. The nature wears a charming look. The flowers bloom everywhere, and the trees turn lush green, making the entire country look vibrant and colourful. One of the best things about spring in Bangladesh is the festivals that come along with it. Pohela Falgun, the first day of spring, is celebrated with much enthusiasm and joy. People dress up in bright and colourful clothes, and the streets are decorated with flowers and banners. Basanta Utsav, the festival of colours, is also celebrated during this season. Another reason why I love spring is that it is the perfect season for outdoor activities. The mild weather makes it ideal for outdoor sports, travelling, picnic, etc. In addition, birdwatchers can indulge in their hobby, as some species of migratory birds visit this country during this season. Overall, spring is the season that brings hope, happiness, and a fresh start to everyone. With its mild weather, colourful landscapes, and festive celebrations, it is no wonder that it is one of the most loved seasons in the country.

The person who works in the farm lands for growing various agricultural products is called a farmer. Usually he lives in a village. He is a very important and useful person in the country. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. He is called the father of food production. But they are heavily devaluated. question_text: Suppose, you are Abir. You have a pen-friend named Zim who lives in Australia. He wants to know about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh. Now, write a letter to him about it.
answer_text:
22/A West Dhanmondi
Dhaka
11 October 2025
Dear Zim,
I hope you're doing well! I'm excited to tell you about the anti-discrimination student movement in Bangladesh, which has made a huge impact on our society. The movement initially began with students rallying for merit-based opportunities. They wanted to end the unfair quota system, which often limited opportunities for qualified students by reserving a large portion of jobs and university seats for specific groups. As this student-led protest grew, people from all walks of life began to join, seeing it as a stand against systemic discrimination and inequality. Over time, the movement evolved from focusing solely on quota reforms to challenging the government's authoritarian actions. The protests became a call for a more democratic and fair system, with the movement finally demanding that the fascist government step down. In the end, it wasn't just about students' rights but about justice and equality for all. The unity between students and the general public showed the strength of a united front against discrimination. Let me know if you want to hear more details!
Best wishes,
Abir

question_text: Newspaper is called the storehouse of knowledge. Almost all educated people read newspaper. Now, write a short composition on "The Benefits of Reading Newspaper".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Future Plan of Life".
answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

question_text: Write a composition on "A journey you have recently enjoyed".
answer_text:
A Journey by boat I Enjoyed/A Journey by boat
A journey by boat can be a tranquil and peaceful experience, where one can enjoy the serene beauty of nature and the rhythmic flow of water. I recently had the opportunity to enjoy a boat trip and it was an experience that I will never forget. It was an autumn vacation. I enjoyed a journey by boat from Mymensingh to Jamalpur along the river Brahmaputra. The journey started early in the morning when we boarded a wooden boat. The boat was not very big, but it was comfortable and had enough space for all of us. We were a group of eight people, including two boatmen. As we set off, the sun was just rising, and the sky was filled with hues of orange and red. The weather was calm, and we could see the reflection of the sky on the surface of the river. As we left the din and bustle of the town behind, the riverine Bangladesh greeted us with its vast water stretching as far as the eyes could see. It reminded us of the past trading activities through riverways. We passed by small villages on the banks of the river, and we saw people going about their daily lives. Some were fishing, others were bathing or washing their clothes. The boat journey took us through different waterways, including canals and streams, where we saw a variety of birdlife. We saw herons, kingfishers, and many other species of birds. The scenery was stunning, with green fields and trees lining the banks of the waterways. At about 10 a.m, we stopped at a small village along the riverside. We had the chance to explore the village and interact with the locals. They were very friendly and hospitable. We bought some snacks for breakfast. Back on the boat, we enjoyed the traditional snacks and tea while taking in the sights and sounds of the river. One of the highlights of the journey was when we stopped at a village to take our lunch. We saw there how the locals make traditional pottery. The potters skillfully shaped the clay into different objects, such as pots, cups, and plates. We even had the opportunity to try our hand at making some pottery ourselves, which was a lot of fun. The journey lasted for several hours, and we enjoyed every moment of it. It was a great way to experience the natural beauty of our country and learn more about the local culture. I would highly recommend a boat journey to anyone who loves nature and adventure. However, a boat journey is a fantastic experience that I will never forget. It offers a unique perspective on the country's natural beauty and cultural heritage. I hope to have the opportunity to do it again someday.

The Benefits of Early Rising
'Early rising' means to get up from bed early in the morning. If one wishes to rise early in the morning, he can make it into a habit. At first he may not be habituated to rise early in the morning. But after rising for some days, he may build such a habit that will encourage him to rise early in the morning spontaneously. So, a time obviously comes when he can't but rise early in the morning. An early riser can be beneficial in various ways. He can enjoy the fresh air of the morning and be mentally refreshed. Walking in the morning builds up his body. He can start his daily work early in the morning. A person who does not rise early in the morning generally faces some problems. He often gets up late and gets late for his office. He can't enjoy the fresh air of the morning. He can't take a walk in the morning which can benefit him physically. On the other hand, an early riser benefits the society in various ways. As he possesses a good health, he may contribute to the country largely. Being a punctual person, he may perform his duties timely. There is an English proverb "Early to bed, early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise."

question_text: Write a composition on "The Season you Like Most".
answer_text:
The Season I Like Most/Best (The Spring)
Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Each season has its own features. Of the six seasons of Bangla year, I love the spring most. It is the king of seasons. The spring is one of the most delightful seasons in Bangladesh. It is the season of rebirth, rejuvenation and renewal. It starts in the month of Falgun (February/March) and lasts until Baishakh (April). The weather in spring is simply magical. The bitter cold of winter gradually fades away, and the cool breeze brings a pleasant feeling all around. There is no heavy rainfall, no dark cloud, or no scorching heat of summer. The bright sunshine and blue skies enhance the beauty of nature. The spring comes with the message of hope and enjoyment. The trees and plants put on new leaves. The nature wears a charming look. The flowers bloom everywhere, and the trees turn lush green, making the entire country look vibrant and colourful. One of the best things about spring in Bangladesh is the festivals that come along with it. Pohela Falgun, the first day of spring, is celebrated with much enthusiasm and joy. People dress up in bright and colourful clothes, and the streets are decorated with flowers and banners. Basanta Utsav, the festival of colours, is also celebrated during this season. Another reason why I love spring is that it is the perfect season for outdoor activities. The mild weather makes it ideal for outdoor sports, travelling, picnic, etc. In addition, birdwatchers can indulge in their hobby, as some species of migratory birds visit this country during this season. Overall, spring is the season that brings hope, happiness, and a fresh start to everyone. With its mild weather, colourful landscapes, and festive celebrations, it is no wonder that it is one of the most loved seasons in the country.

Load-shedding has become a hard nut to crack (কঠিন সমস্যা- gordian knot) in Bangladesh particularly in the urban areas where people largely depend on electricity. It means the discontinuation (ব্যাঘাত) of supply of electricity. It occurs while generation of power falls short of demand. Due to rapid growth of population the demand of electricity has increased to a great extent while the generation of power has not risen expectedly. It mostly occurs in the pick hour of the day that refers to the time from 8 am to 11 pm. When load shedding occurs, the normal life of the people of that area comes to a standstill. It creates the problem of far reaching consequences in the socio-economic (আর্থ-সামাজিক) development of the country. Mills and factories, shops, hospitals come to a standstill. Housewives, students, patients and workers also fall a victim to it. All the electronic devices like refrigerators, televisions, air conditioners, electric fans, computers, diagnostic devices in the hospitals become useless. We are also suffering a lot in our locality due to load-shedding. To get rid of this worst suffering, power generation should be increased. We should also (মিতব্যয়ী) be frugal in using electricity.

question_text: Now a days people are suffering from various diseases. If they take physical exercise everyday, they can enjoy a sound health. Now, write a composition on "The importance of physical exercise". (250 words)
answer_text:
Physical Exercise/ The Importance of Physical Exercise
We have a mind as well as a body. There is an intimate relation between the two. A sound mind goes with a sound body. Physical exercise keeps our body healthy and our mind in proper condition. Physical exercise means the movement of the limbs. It makes one strong and active and keeps one away from diseases. There are various kinds of physical exercise. Swimming, running, walking, riding are good forms of exercise. Gymnastics, wrestling are also good kinds of exercise. Modern outdoor games like football, cricket, hockey, tennis are good physical exercises, too. The village games are the best physical exercise. All forms of exercise are not suitable for all men. If a weak man takes part in a game of football or hockey, he will get tired. Such exercise does him more harm than good. So he should take a milder form of exercise. For young men gymnastics, wrestling and outdoor games are very suitable. There are people who work hard to earn their living. They need not take physical exercise. Again, over exercise does harm to health. So, we should always take such exercise as would suit us. Physical exercise is necessary to develop the brain. A healthy man enjoys life better and has greater happiness. A weak man sees a bear in every bush. He falls an easy prey to disease and death. Many students only sit with their books and refuse to take any exercise. They are soon seen to decline in health. They fall victim to various kinds of diseases, life becomes a burden to them and the world seems to be a prison house to them. Our body is just like an engine. If it is not put in regular service, it may be easily spoiled. So, without regular exercise, we cannot expect to enjoy sound health. We should take some kinds of physical exercise to improve our health.

question_text: Write a paragraph in 250 words on "A Day Labourer".
answer_text:
A Day Labourer
A fellow working on 'no work no pay' basis is normally a day labourer. He is not salaried though not honorary as well. He usually does the work of a farmer massively. He sometimes is engaged in masonry. He becomes a rickshaw puller, a railway porter and a temporary hawker to some extent. He generally has no fixed job. Now he is a stone breaker and then a soil cutter. In the markets of city areas some minor boys keep a basket with them and help the buyers carry their heavy load of shopping to their residence (বাসস্থান). They are also day labourers leading a miserable condition. In our country, a day labourer is not well paid. He works from sunrise to sunset and even late night. But he does not get expected remuneration (পারিশ্রমিক) from their owners. He is sun burnt with a mirth of having due wages. He is drenched with torrents like a storm crow. He shivers in the pinching cold to drag his hard life forward. Of course his joys know no bounds when he earns more. Then he shops with his basket full and returns to his shabby cottage where his diseased wife and some naked or half naked children wait for having some food. But the case is reverse when he goes on without any work. He wears a gloomy (বিষণ্ণ) appearance visualising the famished (না খেয়ে থাকা) mouths of his family. Then he is between two fires what to do for his family members awaiting food with rictus. The rigorous condition of our day labourers ought to be upgraded with the all out effort of both Govt and commoners.

question_text: Write a composition on "Importance of Tree Plantation".
answer_text:
Importance of Tree Plantation/ Afforestation/ Importance of Planting more Trees/ The necessity of tree plantation/ Tree Plantation/ Why do you think more trees should be planted
Since the dawn (উষালগ্ন) of civilization man has a close relation with nature. Nature helps us in many ways. Trees are the indispensable (অবিচ্ছেদ্য) part of nature. They are the gifts of nature. Tree gives us 'Oxygen'. But for the development of human civilization this valuable assets are damaged day by day. For the Rabindranath Tagore says, ‘Give back the forest, take your town”. By these lines he tries to tell us about the importance of trees. So, tree plantation is very important for our life and economy. The people of our country cut down trees at random. So, our country is losing her trees. If this process continues, she will turn into a desert. It is a perfect time that we plant trees to protect our environment. To preserve our environment, we should plant more and more trees. Government order may be passed in order to make the people interested in planting trees. They should be made aware that our economy is dependent on trees. Trees bear a great impact (প্রভাব) on the climate. If we destroy trees at random, one day the country will turn into a great desert. The country will bear the consequences (পরিণাম) of Green House Effect. Again there will be no rain and as a result, the country will face a great crisis because ours is an agricultural country and our economy is dependent on agriculture. Again our agriculture depends on rain. So trees play a vital role on our climate. Trees keep the soil strong. Trees save us from flood and many other natural calamities. There is a model for afforestation (বনায়ন) in Bangladesh. Sea beaches, low lying areas and fallowlands (পতিত জমি) can be brought under the scheme of afforestation with special types of trees suited to the soil. Shady trees and fruit trees should be planted by the side of roads and high ways. Trees may be planted in all sides of ponds and dighis in village. June and July are the best time for tree plantation. Tree plantation programme should be expanded to the remote corner of the country. Most of the people of our country do not know about the utility and the importance of trees and forests. For this reason government should make TV programme or radio programme on the subjects of afforestation. Trees are part and parcel of our life. So, it is our duty to plant more trees and take care of them in order to maintain balance between man and nature.

question_text: Everyone has his/ her favourite game. Now, write a composition on 'Your favourite game' focusing the reasons behind your liking. (250 words)
answer_text:
My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most
All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football more than all other games. The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side. The game is generally played for ninety minutes. In the field the referee is the supreme authority to conduct the game. His decision is final. Two lines men assist him to run the game smoothly and properly. During the play no player except the goalkeeper can touch the ball with hands. No player in the game can make any foul, In case of making any foul the referee can send any player off the field. The victory goes to the team that can score more goals than the other. The game of football teaches us the principle of obedience to rules. It fosters the spirit of love, discipline and co-operation among the players. It develops team spirit and sportsmanship in the players. There is nothing which is an unmixed blessing. Too much involvement in the game often makes students apathetic towards their studies. Rivalry in the play often leads to quarrell among the supporters in the gallery and spoils the thrill and joy of the game. Sometimes it goes to touch extent that the whole ground turns into a battle field. But inspite of having some negative sides, football is the most popular and exciting game in the world.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Moonlit Night".
answer_text:
A Moon-lit Night
A moonlit night is a night when the moon beams with its full size and gleam. Such a night looks very beautiful. The whole nature takes a heavenly look. People come out of homes so that they can enjoy the glamourous night, especially the cloudless one. People rush on the roads and open square to enjoy the beauties of nature. Some enjoy gossiping, some play pipes in the fields and some others sing songs. The children and women also come out to watch the moon-lit night. They become excited and amazed to watch the beauty of nature. The poets write poems about the moon-lit night. They describe it with their imagination. Even common people try to compose poems in such a splendid situation. A moon-lit night reminds us of the renowned song of Rabindranath Tagore "Chander Hashi Bandh Bhengeche." I have a memory of experiencing a moonlit night at our village home when I went there during my summer vacation. On that night, the moon was beaming lavishly. The brightness of the moon's light was so heavy that it looked like almost day light. To see that brilliance of the moon's light, our joys knew no bound. Infact, a moonlit night is a blessing of the Almighty to all his dearly creatures.

question_text: Imagine, you are Sumon/ Sumona, a student of Jamalpur Zilla School, Jamalpur. There is no canteen in your school. The students have to stay for a long time in the school. So they need Tiffin. Now, write an application to your Headmaster on behalf of the students for setting up a canteen in your school.
answer_text:
13 March 2025
The Headmaster
Jamalpur Zilla School, Jamalpur
Subject : Request for setting up a canteen.
Dear Sir,
We, the students of your renowned school, have the honour to draw your kind attention to the fact that there is no canteen in our school. We have to stay for a long time in the school. Passing this long period without tiffin is very difficult. If the students can't have some snacks in the tiffin period, they get feeble and consequently can't concentrate on lesson. Besides, it also may cause vearious stomach diseases like gastic and ulcer. For want of a canteen many students take unhyegenic food from road-side which is also very harmful to health. Most often the students get sick taking food from outside the school. As morning shift in our school starts at 7:00 am, many students have to come to school without breakfast. If there was a canteen in the school, they could have some food from there. We, therefore, pray and hope that you would take initiative to set up a canteen in our school as soon as possible and thus mitigate the above mentioned problem.
Sincerely yours
Shovo
On behalf of the pupils of your school

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby".
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Your Visit to a Book Fair".
answer_text:
My Visit to a Book Fair
A book fair is a special kind of fair where various kinds of books are displayed and sold. It gives an opportunity to buy different types of books at the same place. Recently I have visited a book fair at the Bangla Academy premises (চত্বর). Actually, it is an annual function and Bangla Academy authorities arrange the fair in memory of the language martyrs. It is termed "Amor Ekushey Boi Mela." When I entered the mela premises, I was really pleased at the calm and quiet environment. Though it was brimming (কানায় কানায় পূর্ণ) with people, there was no chaotic situation (বিশৃঙ্খল অবস্থা). I saw book lovers humming in the stalls without any trouble. I bought some books of varied interests. According to my list I collected some valuable books without any hazard. The decoration of the premises also pleased me very much. I was really fortunate as I met some eminent (প্রখ্যাত) writers of our country and I took autographs from them. Actually, I was really pleased at the fair and I hope it will uphold our culture in the arena of world literature (বিশ্ব সাহিত্য).

question_text: Suppose, you are Sabuj/Sathi living in Chattogram. You know that road accidents are now daily occurrences in our country. It takes a heavy toll of life. Now, write a email to your friend Sagor/Nadi about the causes and effects of road accidents and how to solve this problem.
answer_text:
To: sagor_2013@yahoo.com
Subject : Causes and effects of road accidents
Dear Sagor,
I received your email yesterday. In your email you mentioned about a road accident that you witnessed. I feel sorry for your condition.
Actually road safety in our country is in a pitiable state. The number of road accidents is increasing day by day. As a result, a number of unnatural deaths take place almost every day and several become physically handicapped or permanently disabled. Most accidents happen due to reckless driving. People in their hurry don't care to follow the traffic signals. The pedestrians tend to cross the roads from anywhere they want and are in turn hit by speeding vehicles. The truck drivers, generally drunk, the young rash scooterists—all add to the number of road accidents. A few strict steps like imposing heavy fines and forfeiting the license of the offenders could stop the people from going wild on the road. Authorities need to be more stringent in issuing driving licenses. Constant checking and vigil are required.
I hope the concerned authorities and the general public will see the gravity of the matter and adopt some measures.
No more today. Write to me soon and take care.
Sincerely yours,
Sabuj

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Aim in Life".
answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A School Magazine".
answer_text:
A School Magazine (বিদ্যালয় সাময়িকী)
A school magazine is an important part of any educational institution. It is a publication that is created by students and teachers alike and showcases the achievements, ideas, and creativity of the school community. A school magazine typically contains a range of content, from news and current events to features on the school's sports teams, clubs, and extracurricular activities. It may also feature interviews with teachers, students, and community members, as well as artwork, poetry, and short stories. In addition to providing an outlet for students' creativity, a school magazine can also help to foster a sense of community within the school. It allows students to learn about and appreciate the diverse talents and interests of their peers, and to celebrate their collective achievements. Publishing a school magazine is a valuable learning experience for students, as it requires collaboration, research, writing, editing, and design skills. Students who participate in the creation of the magazine gain valuable experience in journalism, publishing, and media production, which can be useful for them in their future academic and professional endeavours. Overall, a school magazine is an important part of the school community, providing a forum for students to express themselves, showcase their talents, and celebrate their accomplishments. It is a testament to the creativity, diversity, and academic excellence of the school, and an enduring record of the memories and experiences shared by its students.
