question_text: Write a composition on "Science in Everyday Life".
answer_text:
Science in Everyday Life
We can't imagine our life without science. It is associated with us greatly. Modern life cannot be thought without science. It has made our life easier and comfortable. We feel sound because of its so many gifts. They have removed our sufferings to a great extent. We see innumerous blessings of science in our daily life. Electricity, motor vehicles, domestic appliances, TV, Radio, Radar, aeroplane, ship, computer etc have made our life easier and comfortable. Science has relieved human sufferings. Electricity is a wonderful creation of science. With it we run domestic appliances, mills, factories, machines of various kinds and the liking. Without electricity life would come to a standstill (স্থবির). Now we can travel any place of the world quickly. Fast moving vehicles like motor bus, cars, trains and aeroplanes have saved our time. We can travel miles after miles within a short span of time. Concord plane can take us from Bangladesh to New York, even, in two hours. Actually, vehicles have given us speed in our life. Education has been made easier by the goodness of science. Printing press has made books cheap and available to masses. Thousands of books and magazines are printed and widely circulated by scientific means within very short time. All these spread education among people. Telephone, telegram, fax, telex, wireless (বেতার) work like miracles. E-mail and mobile phones have brought out changes in communication. We can now talk to near ones as well as see the persons talking with. The use of computer has done unbelievable advancement in communication. Radio and television have conquered space, time and object. We see the whole world in our drawing room through dish antenna. Scientific methods have made cultivation and irrigation easier. Power tiller, power pump have enhanced agricultural activities. Scientific tools have made life long. They have lessened human sufferings to a great extent. A modern hospital cannot run without the help of modern science. Life saving medicines x-ray, ultrasonograph, ECG etc have made it easier to identify diseases. We see everywhere the influence of science. Its blessings are innumerable (অসংখ্য) and we are blessed with it. We need to make the proper use of science in our practical life.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Our National Flag".
answer_text:
Our National Flag (আমাদের জাতীয় পতাকা)
The national flag of Bangladesh is a symbol of pride and identity for the people of the country. It features a deep green background with a large red disc in the centre, representing the rising sun. The color green symbolizes the country's lush vegetation and agricultural heritage, while the red disc represents the bloodshed and sacrifices made during the struggle for independence from Pakistan in 1971. The flag has a rectangular shape with a length to width ratio of 10:6. The size of the national flag is regulated by law, with specifications for the proportions and dimensions of the flag for different occasions and uses. The flag is flown on public and private buildings, during national holidays and events, and on official government vehicles. The flag is also an essential component of the country's diplomatic representation abroad, and it is prominently displayed at Bangladeshi embassies and high commissions worldwide. The national flag is kept half-mast on the occasion of national mourning day and on the 21st February. However, our national flag is not just a piece of cloth, but it represents the identity and dignity of the nation. The flag serves as a unifying force that brings the people of Bangladesh together under a common goal of progress, development, and prosperity. The national flag of Bangladesh is a powerful symbol of the country's past, present, and future, and it inspires a sense of patriotism and national pride in the hearts of its citizens.

question_text: Write a composition on "Duties of a Student".
answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

question_text: Suppose, you experienced a traffic jam last week. Now, write a paragraph on "A Traffic Jam You Experienced".
answer_text:
A Traffic Jam I Experienced
Bangladesh is a populous country. About 140 million people live here. A lot of vehicles is needed for a lot of people. That is why, a traffic jam is a very common scene in Bangladesh. Last week, I was trapped in a heavy traffic jam in front of the City College on Mirpur Road. I went to New Market to take a birthday cake for my younger sister. Her birthday was on that day. I had to stay there for about 3 hours. So, I felt very much embarrassed. There are many chances why traffic jams occur. Reckless driving, disobeying of traffic rules and overtaking other vehicles are some of the causes of traffic jam. In our daily life, traffic jam creates a lot of problems. People cannot go from one place to another easily. To get rid of this problem, we have to take some necessary steps. The roads should be widened. The drivers should obey traffic rules and should not overtake any vehicles. To lead the country to the path of development we should be careful to solve the problem of traffic jam.

question_text: Suppose, you are Abid/Abida. Naveed is your younger brother. You have heard that he is keeping some evil companions nowadays. Now, write an email to your younger brother advising him to avoid evil company.
answer_text:
To: naveed99@gmail.com
Subject : Avoid your evil company for a bright future!
My dear Naveed,
I have received an alarming email from father that you are not regular in studies. Your progress report of last month collected from your institution was not satisfactory at all. Your score in the final examination has shocked us greatly. He has also written that you are mixing with bad companions. Our family has an excellent background of education. Now, the present financial condition of our family is not so good.
My dear brother, remember that time and tide wait for none. So, I tell you to be quite serious to your studies. To face the challenge of life you must take proper education. It is the proper time for you to achieve education. In student life as you sow, so you will reap. So, you should study hard and you must give up evil companies but you can mix with good companies. Therefore I hope that you will follow my advice.
No more today. With love to you all.
Yours elderly,
Abid

question_text: Write a composition on "The Uses of Computer in Everyday Life".
answer_text:
The uses of Computer in Everyday Life
The latest wonder of science that has added a new dimension to the modern civilization is computer. It is the machine by which the science is trying to substitute human brain. The use of computer is immense. There is hardly any sector of modern human activities where computer is not used. Space technology, medical science, defense, scientific research, administration etc. cannot do without the use of computer. Our everyday life is also greatly involved in using computer. In the field of education computer plays an important role. Very important books, dictionary, scientific invention, discovery, medical research etc. are launched through internet. Student can be greatly benefited by browsing these sites in computer. For exchanging information computer is very effective. We can be informed of the happenings (ঘটনাপ্রবাহ) around the world within a very short time through internet. We can read newspaper, journals, information about various institutions, companies, products of various brands, sports news etc. through computer. Act of business is also being performed through computer. Computer has made the banking activities easier and more reliable. Balance check, money transfer, deposit, withdrawal etc. can be done by the credit card with the help of computer. Offices can do little without using computer. Corresponding with others, printing text, making documents, calculating, data processing, data finding etc. are performed in the offices very quickly and correctly through computer. In the field of transport computer plays an importants role. Trains and planes are run with the help of computer. It is used for preparing electric bill, telephone bill, gas bill, water bill. The entire function of mobile communication is regulated by computer. The function of stock exchange is regulated by computer. It is also a component of recreation. Children use it for playing game. Adults also use it for watching movie and enjoying music. Infact, the use of computer in the present world is endless. We can't think our modern life without computer. It can be said that the development of a country depends to some extent on using computer.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Book Fair".
answer_text:
A Book Fair
A book fair is of fairly a recent origin. It is a fair where different types of books are displayed for sale. Nowadays book fair has become very popular. A book fair is usually held in the months of January and February. In our country it is held in almost all cities and towns. The largest book fair is organized by Bangla Academy on the occasion of the 21st February. It is called the "Amar Ekushe Boi Mela". It has created a sense of interest for books amongst the general mass. In a book fair various types of pavillions are set up. Different sorts of books like fictions, text books, dramas, children books, reference books etc. are displayed catagorically. There are also snacks, food and drink stalls. A book fair becomes crowdy specially in the evening. Customers irrespective of age, gender, caste and creed gather at a book fair. Renowned and promising writers visit the fiar regularly. Seminars and cultural programmes are held. The main purpose of a book fair is not only sale but it offers a rare opportunity to assess the advancement made in publication of books. It helps to create new writers as well as new readers. It inspires all sections of people to form the habit of reading. A book fair bears the testimony of the refined tastes and varied culture of a country. A book fair reminds us that books change our outlook on life and widens our domain of knowledge. Readers get these best friends at a cheaper rate from a book fair. Thus, book fairs are of great value as they help to build an enlightened society and nation.

question_text: Suppose, you are Anuvob/Anuva. You have a pen friend named Javan who lives in the USA. He wants to know about your country. Now, write a letter to your friend describing your country.
answer_text:
Oxford Mission Road, Barishal
08 March 2025
Dear Jovan,
How do you do, my dear? Ok? I hope so. A few days ago you wrote a letter to me which is yet unanswered for my some technical problems. In your letter you expressed a heart felt and exalted devotion to know about my darling motherland and her people. Now be mindful and pay heed to the following fact. Bangladesh is a South Asian country with a tiny area and a big population. The people here are of various creeds, castes, customs. The riverine country, Bangladesh, is a natural fair of natural goods such as forest land, running rivers, sea beach, hilly areas, stagnant beel, jheel etc. The natural sequences surrounding and embracing our land are a panorama of vision. The Sundarbans and Kuakata sea beach of South Bangla, Cox's Bazar sea beach of south-easternmost zone of Bangladesh, the river basin of the Padma, the Meghna and the Jamuna-all these are the hoarders of pictorial quality of a poet's brush. You can see here acres of meadow or grass land, innumerable fields across the meadow, countless gleaners gleaning in the fields during the harvesting season, juice oozing from the date top during the winter, minstrels or bards wandering about in villages and hamlets in our agro and village based country. Six seasons, prevalent in Bangladesh, are a newer experience for you respectively. Flood often visits my Bangladesh due to her geographical position or stand and climatic condition. In fact, natural disasters perform here like a brutal step mother. Despite manifold natural adversities we are heading as a independent nation towards world standard respecting education, culture, solidarity, state policy and parity between men and communities. Oh yes, the people of our country are extraordinarily amiable. We have laid down our lives for language and liberty of state and idea. You, therefore, cannot blow away our sense of fraternity, solidarity and unity. We are not as white as you in complexion but trying with our level best to be as civilised as you. I am putting an ending mark now and you are ardently expected to be our tropical land during the next dry season.
Your friend,
Anuvob

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Game".
answer_text:
My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most
All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football more than all other games. The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side. The game is generally played for ninety minutes. In the field the referee is the supreme authority to conduct the game. His decision is final. Two lines men assist him to run the game smoothly and properly. During the play no player except the goalkeeper can touch the ball with hands. No player in the game can make any foul, In case of making any foul the referee can send any player off the field. The victory goes to the team that can score more goals than the other. The game of football teaches us the principle of obedience to rules. It fosters the spirit of love, discipline and co-operation among the players. It develops team spirit and sportsmanship in the players. There is nothing which is an unmixed blessing. Too much involvement in the game often makes students apathetic towards their studies. Rivalry in the play often leads to quarrell among the supporters in the gallery and spoils the thrill and joy of the game. Sometimes it goes to touch extent that the whole ground turns into a battle field. But inspite of having some negative sides, football is the most popular and exciting game in the world.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "The Life of a Farmer".
answer_text:
The Life of a Farmer/A Farmer (একজন কৃষকের জীবন/একজন কৃষক)
The person who works in the farm lands for growing various agricultural products is called a farmer. Usually he lives in a village. He is a very important and useful person in the country. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. He is called the father of food production. But they are heavily devaluated. He gets up from bed early in the morning and takes a pair of bullocks and plough to cultivate his land. He works all day long in his land. In Bangladesh, farmers lead a very miserable life. If he can produce good crops, his face beams with joy. On the contrary, if he fails to grow, his sorrows know no bounds. Most farmers of our country live under poverty level. They live from hand to mouth. Bangladesh is mainly an agricultural country. Her prosperity depends on the development of agriculture. That is why, I cannot think of her without a farmer. Therefore, the farmer's prevalent condition ought to be upgraded to help his life reach a standard level.

question_text: Write a composition on "Science in Everyday Life".
answer_text:
Science in Everyday Life
We can't imagine our life without science. It is associated with us greatly. Modern life cannot be thought without science. It has made our life easier and comfortable. We feel sound because of its so many gifts. They have removed our sufferings to a great extent. We see innumerous blessings of science in our daily life. Electricity, motor vehicles, domestic appliances, TV, Radio, Radar, aeroplane, ship, computer etc have made our life easier and comfortable. Science has relieved human sufferings. Electricity is a wonderful creation of science. With it we run domestic appliances, mills, factories, machines of various kinds and the liking. Without electricity life would come to a standstill (স্থবির). Now we can travel any place of the world quickly. Fast moving vehicles like motor bus, cars, trains and aeroplanes have saved our time. We can travel miles after miles within a short span of time. Concord plane can take us from Bangladesh to New York, even, in two hours. Actually, vehicles have given us speed in our life. Education has been made easier by the goodness of science. Printing press has made books cheap and available to masses. Thousands of books and magazines are printed and widely circulated by scientific means within very short time. All these spread education among people. Telephone, telegram, fax, telex, wireless (বেতার) work like miracles. E-mail and mobile phones have brought out changes in communication. We can now talk to near ones as well as see the persons talking with. The use of computer has done unbelievable advancement in communication. Radio and television have conquered space, time and object. We see the whole world in our drawing room through dish antenna. Scientific methods have made cultivation and irrigation easier. Power tiller, power pump have enhanced agricultural activities. Scientific tools have made life long. They have lessened human sufferings to a great extent. A modern hospital cannot run without the help of modern science. Life saving medicines x-ray, ultrasonograph, ECG etc have made it easier to identify diseases. We see everywhere the influence of science. Its blessings are innumerable (অসংখ্য) and we are blessed with it. We need to make the proper use of science in our practical life.

question_text: Our farmers play an important role in our agro-based society. They work from dawn to dusk in order to produce crops. Now, write a paragraph on "The life of a farmer".
answer_text:
The Life of a Farmer/A Farmer (একজন কৃষকের জীবন/একজন কৃষক)
The person who works in the farm lands for growing various agricultural products is called a farmer. Usually he lives in a village. He is a very important and useful person in the country. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. He is called the father of food production. But they are heavily devaluated. He gets up from bed early in the morning and takes a pair of bullocks and plough to cultivate his land. He works all day long in his land. In Bangladesh, farmers lead a very miserable life. If he can produce good crops, his face beams with joy. On the contrary, if he fails to grow, his sorrows know no bounds. Most farmers of our country live under poverty level. They live from hand to mouth. Bangladesh is mainly an agricultural country. Her prosperity depends on the development of agriculture. That is why, I cannot think of her without a farmer. Therefore, the farmer's prevalent condition ought to be upgraded to help his life reach a standard level.

question_text: Suppose, you are Ayan/Anni. You live in B-3/Gopalpur, Haji Mohammad Mohosin Road, Pabna. Your friend is Farhan/Farhana who is living in 13/B, Purana Paltan, Dhaka-1216. Now, write an email to your friend describing a road accident you have recently witnessed in your town.
answer_text:
To : farhany2k@gmail.com
Subject : About a road accident
Dear Farhan,
Hope, you are safe and sound by the grace of almighty Allah. I am also well by His blessings. However, you definitely know street accident frequently (ঘন ঘন) occurs in our country. As a result, valuable lives and liabilities are lost. Last week, I have watched a terrible (ভয়ঙ্কর) street accident at the point of Malibag. You might have read it in the newspaper as it was published in the Daily Janakantha the following day. It took place at 4.00 pm. A bus coming from Tongi pushed a rickshaw from behind. Then and there the innocent rickshaw puller stumbled down on the street. The pedestrians (পথচারি) stood around him and got very excited at this. They seized the bus driver and beat him mercilessly (নির্মমভাবে). Then the police came to the spot and saved him from public reaction. The police investigated the spot and seized the bus.
I felt very grieved at the unnatural death of the poor fellow. I could not even sleep at that night. Now I feel light informing you of the dreadful accident.
Please be careful while passing through any street.
With best wishes to you.
Your loving friend,
Ayan

question_text: Write a composition on "Importance of trees in our life".
answer_text:
Importance of Trees in Our Daily Life/ Tree plantation/ Why do you think more trees should be planted
Trees are our first friends both for our soul and sole existence. We cannot live anyhow beyond five minutes without taking oxygen that trees give off taking in carbon-dioxide. Trees, therefore, preserve our physical subsistence (অস্তিত্ব) first. Then trees are playing vital role in nature. These are protecting severe green house effect, resisting the unbridled erosion of soil and fighting as massive prevention against various natural disasters and disorders maintaining the interrelation among components of nature. We are preparing residence under the shady haunts of trees, nature's greatest boon. We eat to live for which we need food and trees are the container of food of various species. We are using various vehicles some of which are made of wood and wood's begetter is tree. Lots of edifice buildings (সুরম্য অট্টালিকা) of the world are the direct contribution of trees. Trees always function in our construction sphere. All these contributions of trees are the bodily ones. Tress obviously control our mental hemisphere no doubt. Trees are the ornament of our beauty queen nature. Various sorts of flowers of each and every season are giving manifold (বহুমুখী) shapes of our nature. Various festivals are being well accomplished in the appealing and colourful environment for the usual presence of fragrant and colourful flowers. In the ocular world we are using many things majority of which directly or indirectly are linked with trees whose medicinal qualities (ঔষধি গুণ) are needless to note here. Trees are the fathers of herbal chemistry that is constantly influencing our daily life. In broader sense, one can say in fine that from cradle to grave or burning ghat trees are the greatest functionaries in his daily life. To sum up, trees are saving us from the different natural malady (ব্যাধি).

question_text: Farmer is a very familiar figure in our country. He plays a great role in our agro based society. But he leads a very miserable life for financial problem. Now, write a paragraph on "The Life of a Farmer".
answer_text:
The Life of a Farmer/A Farmer (একজন কৃষকের জীবন/একজন কৃষক)
The person who works in the farm lands for growing various agricultural products is called a farmer. Usually he lives in a village. He is a very important and useful person in the country. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. He is called the father of food production. But they are heavily devaluated. He gets up from bed early in the morning and takes a pair of bullocks and plough to cultivate his land. He works all day long in his land. In Bangladesh, farmers lead a very miserable life. If he can produce good crops, his face beams with joy. On the contrary, if he fails to grow, his sorrows know no bounds. Most farmers of our country live under poverty level. They live from hand to mouth. Bangladesh is mainly an agricultural country. Her prosperity depends on the development of agriculture. That is why, I cannot think of her without a farmer. Therefore, the farmer's prevalent condition ought to be upgraded to help his life reach a standard level.

question_text: Journey is always pleasant. Suppose, you have made a journey by boat recently. Now, write a composition on "A Journey by Boat".
answer_text:
A Journey by boat I Enjoyed/A Journey by boat
A journey by boat can be a tranquil and peaceful experience, where one can enjoy the serene beauty of nature and the rhythmic flow of water. I recently had the opportunity to enjoy a boat trip and it was an experience that I will never forget. It was an autumn vacation. I enjoyed a journey by boat from Mymensingh to Jamalpur along the river Brahmaputra. The journey started early in the morning when we boarded a wooden boat. The boat was not very big, but it was comfortable and had enough space for all of us. We were a group of eight people, including two boatmen. As we set off, the sun was just rising, and the sky was filled with hues of orange and red. The weather was calm, and we could see the reflection of the sky on the surface of the river. As we left the din and bustle of the town behind, the riverine Bangladesh greeted us with its vast water stretching as far as the eyes could see. It reminded us of the past trading activities through riverways. We passed by small villages on the banks of the river, and we saw people going about their daily lives. Some were fishing, others were bathing or washing their clothes. The boat journey took us through different waterways, including canals and streams, where we saw a variety of birdlife. We saw herons, kingfishers, and many other species of birds. The scenery was stunning, with green fields and trees lining the banks of the waterways. At about 10 a.m, we stopped at a small village along the riverside. We had the chance to explore the village and interact with the locals. They were very friendly and hospitable. We bought some snacks for breakfast. Back on the boat, we enjoyed the traditional snacks and tea while taking in the sights and sounds of the river. One of the highlights of the journey was when we stopped at a village to take our lunch. We saw there how the locals make traditional pottery. The potters skillfully shaped the clay into different objects, such as pots, cups, and plates. We even had the opportunity to try our hand at making some pottery ourselves, which was a lot of fun. The journey lasted for several hours, and we enjoyed every moment of it. It was a great way to experience the natural beauty of our country and learn more about the local culture. I would highly recommend a boat journey to anyone who loves nature and adventure. However, a boat journey is a fantastic experience that I will never forget. It offers a unique perspective on the country's natural beauty and cultural heritage. I hope to have the opportunity to do it again someday.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Road Accident".
answer_text:
A Road Accident
Road accidents are very common incidents in our country particularly (বিশেষ করে) in the city areas. To say, it happens frequently and regularly here and there in our surroundings. Recently, I have had an experience of witnessing such a serious road accident. The accident took place last week on the main Thana Sarak near our school, while I along with some of my friends was coming home from school. The road was not so busy at that time. Some buses and cars were plying usually. But all on a sudden there happened a crash in the twinkle of an eye. A bus losing control pushed a microbus plying aside and the microbus driver hit some passers-by who were walking along the foot path. One of them was run over by that microbus and was bleeding seriously in his head. The other two were also seriously injured. There raised a hue and cry. We, the students instantly decided to take the injured to the nearby hospital. We called a van and took them all to the hospital. We reached the hospital within half an hour. But the man who was bleeding in his head died after being taken to the doctor. I felt I could save them all by all my means. But I felt helpless and shocked. question_text: Write a composition in 250 words on "Importance of Reading Newspaper".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: You are seen that 'Dengue Fever' is taking away a lot of lives from different districts in our country. Now, write a paragraph on "How to fight against it and face it".
answer_text:
How to fight against Dengue Fever and face it
The dengue outbreak in the recent time has been very widespread in the major cities and towns of Bangladesh. People of all classes have been affected by this disease. This is a mosquito-borne viral disease. According to sources of various news agencies, about 20 thousand people have been attacked with this epidemic. At least 100 people died in different places. The problem has taken a strong shape in Dhaka city. Every day new dengue patients are getting admitted in the hospitals of Dhaka city. The government agencies and health workers are struggling hard to overcome the issue. All types of leaves of the doctors and other health workers have been cancelled. The government is trying its best to cope with the situation. They have also urged people to keep their areas clean and use all other familial measures by themselves. From our side, we should follow the paths of prevention. To face and remain safe from dengue fever, we must keep our homes, residence and the surrounding area clean. The houses should be free from all kinds of pots and bottles containing stagnant water for many days. All the members of the family must use net for sleeping both at day and night. Besides they can wear thick clothes and stocking both inside and outside of home. However, if anybody is attacked with dengue fever, he must take enough rest. He can also take paracetamol type tablet. And if the fever rises he must see a doctor. However, if we follow these preventive measures, we will be able to fight dengue fever and face it unitedly.

Satellite TV Channels and Our young Generation
Satellite is a machine that has been sent into space (মহাকাশ) and goes round the earth, moon, etc. It is used for radio, television and other electronic communications. On the contrary, channel means a station by which various types of programmes are broadcast. Satellite channels are those that are able to broadcast programmes globally. They play a very important role in providing us with amazement and amusement. Amusing lives cannot be imagined without satellite channels. Through satellite channels we can enjoy educational, literary, cultural and entertaining games and sports programmes. They enrich our mind and mentality with international life awakening flow. They introduce us to global culture and custom. Therefore, their utility in our modern life cannot be denied. There are various satellite channels. They are Desh TV, ATN, Channel I, ETV, RTV, Baishakhi, Bangla Vision, Zee Cinema, Star Plus, Star Movies, Star Sports, Sony, ESPN, National Geography, Al-Jajeera, Cartoon Network, BBC, CNN, AXN, ZTV, MTV, HBO, PTV, and what not. It is true that satellite channels are of great use to us. But they are not an unmixed blessing for us. By broadcasting nude programmes some channels provoke juvenile delinquency. The young generation is losing their social values by watching foreign programmes. By watching vulgar films they go to dogs. Social crimes like killing, raping, kidnapping, robbing are committed owing to the influence of satellite channels. Therefore, effective steps should be taken to save our young generation from deterioration (ধ্বংস) caused by satellite channels.

question_text: All the beings depend on trees for their existence. So we should plant trees more and more every year. Now, write a paragraph on "Tree Plantation".
answer_text:
Tree Plantation/ Importance of Trees
Tree plantation means planting more trees and plants. The purpose of tree plantation is to save the endangered (বিপদগ্রস্ত করা) environment and to beautify our life. Tree plantation is very important because it serves many useful purposes. We get flowers, fruits, fuel and timber from trees. Trees make air fresh and improve the environment. They save us from natural calamities like drought, storms, floods, etc. They increase the beauty of nature. They give us oxygen and take up carbon dioxide and thus maintain ecological (বাস্তুসংস্থানগত) balance. In absence of trees, the country will turn into a desert. So trees are a valuable asset for our existence. Among the seasons, rainy season is the best time for tree plantation. We can plant trees around our dwelling places and in open places. Moreover, trees can be planted by the roads, rivers, canals and playing fields. Awareness should be raised and campaign should be launched to motivate people for tree plantation. Thus we can make the tree plantation programme a success.

answer_text:
Chattogram
18 March 2025
My Dear Masuda,
Thank you so much for the prestigious present you sent me on the occasion of my 16th birthday. I had long been thinking of buying an edition of 'Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary' by Hornby. It seems to me a miracle that you could read my mind and sent me just the book I wanted eagerly. I have got a lot of presents on my birthday, but yours is the best. Father is loud in praise of your choice. In fact, it is a nice dictionary as it contains not only the meanings of the words, but also their different usages which we need to learn English. However, I must say that though your present pleased me very much, I would have been happier if you were yourself present here on the occasion. I missed you very much.
Yours ever,
Samia

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby".
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Suppose, on the last vacation you were going to Rajshahi by bus. Unfortunately your bus met an accident but luckily there was no casualty or death. Now, write a paragraph on "Causes of Road Accidents in Bangladesh".
answer_text:
Causes of Road Accidents in Bangladesh
At present road accidents are regular happenings in Bangladesh. Generally road accidents take place in the urban areas and in the highways. The causes of road accidents are reckless driving, brake failures of vehicles, over-taking of one vehicle by another, driving by unskilled (অদক্ষ) drivers. Over loading of vehicles is another reason for accidents. Another reason is violation (লঙ্ঘন) of traffic rules. Even the police cannot control the traffic rule breakers. Sometimes pedestrians (পথচারী) are crashed under the wheels of heavy vehicles. Sometimes the speedy vehicles fall into the roadside ditch or into the river and thus kill the passengers on the spot. Many lives are nipped in the bud. Many a family loses the only earning member. Many people become crippled. During the last vacation I met with an accident on my way to Rajshahi by bus. Luckily nobody was hurt. So road accident is like a curse in our life. This problem can be solved by all out efforts from both the authority and the general mass. To do so, first our general people have to be made aware. The drivers have to be skilled and they also have to avoid their overtaking tendency (প্রবণতা). And the authority should be more strict to enforce the rules. And these steps must be taken immediately to prevent road accidents.
[Words : 213]

question_text: Nowadays people are suffering from various diseases. If they take physical exercise everyday, they can enjoy a sound health. Now, write a composition on "The Importance of Physical Exercise".
answer_text:
Physical Exercise/ The Importance of Physical Exercise
We have a mind as well as a body. There is an intimate relation between the two. A sound mind goes with a sound body. Physical exercise keeps our body healthy and our mind in proper condition. Physical exercise means the movement of the limbs. It makes one strong and active and keeps one away from diseases. There are various kinds of physical exercise. Swimming, running, walking, riding are good forms of exercise. Gymnastics, wrestling are also good kinds of exercise. Modern outdoor games like football, cricket, hockey, tennis are good physical exercises, too. The village games are the best physical exercise. All forms of exercise are not suitable for all men. If a weak man takes part in a game of football or hockey, he will get tired. Such exercise does him more harm than good. So he should take a milder form of exercise. For young men gymnastics, wrestling and outdoor games are very suitable. There are people who work hard to earn their living. They need not take physical exercise. Again, over exercise does harm to health. So, we should always take such exercise as would suit us. Physical exercise is necessary to develop the brain. A healthy man enjoys life better and has greater happiness. A weak man sees a bear in every bush. He falls an easy prey to disease and death. Many students only sit with their books and refuse to take any exercise. They are soon seen to decline in health. They fall victim to various kinds of diseases, life becomes a burden to them and the world seems to be a prison house to them. Our body is just like an engine. If it is not put in regular service, it may be easily spoiled. So, without regular exercise, we cannot expect to enjoy sound health. We should take some kinds of physical exercise to improve our health.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Tea Stall" in your own words.
answer_text:
A Tea Stall (চায়ের দোকান)
A tea stall is an ever-present and essential part of daily life. This humble roadside establishment is where people gather to catch up with friends, engage in discussions, and take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The tea stall is typically a simple structure, consisting of a few wooden benches or plastic chairs, a small counter, and a large saucepan/cauldron of boiling water and a saucepan of milk for making tea. Customers can enjoy a hot cup of tea with a variety of snacks like biscuits, samosas, or singaras. The tea stall is a great equalizer, where people from all avenues of life come together to share a moment of relaxation. It is not uncommon to see students, office workers, shopkeepers, and even rickshaw pullers taking a break at the tea stall. The atmosphere is usually lively, with the sound of clinking glasses and chatter filling the air. In the evening, tea stalls transform into social hubs, where people gather to discuss politics, sports, and current affairs. A tea stall is not just a place to drink tea, it is a cultural phenomenon that reflects the warmth and hospitality of the people of our country. For many, a tea stall is a daily ritual, a place to unwind, and a respite from the chaos of the outside world. Whether you are a local or a tourist, a visit to a tea stall is a must-do experience that will leave you with a newfound appreciation for the simple pleasures of life.

question_text: Write a composition about "The Importance of Reading Newspaper".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Street Hawker" within 150 words.
answer_text:
A Street Hawker
A man who sells various things by moving from street to street is a street hawker. He is a self-employed (স্বনিয়োজিত) person. He usually lives in a slum or in a house at a very low rent. He is a familiar (অতিপরিচিত) figure. He is seen almost everywhere in a village or in a town. He carries his materials on head and sometimes in hand and sometimes in a small handcart (হস্তচালিত গাড়ি). He earns his livelihood by selling cheap goods. He is a very cunning person. He buys goods at a cheaper rate and sells at a good profit. He sells toys, cosmetics, ready-made garments, utensils, sweets, ribbons, fruits, etc. He usually appears at noon or in the absence of the house master. He speaks in different ways, wears colourful dress and sometimes plays flute or raises high voice to draw the attention (মনোযোগ আকর্ষণ) of his customers. He walks for hours to sell his goods. Thus he passes his days by selling these goods. He gets up early in the morning and sorts his products for selling. He leads a very simple life. He has to toil a lot to earn his livelihood. He somehow manages his family with hardship. Even though he works hard and adopts (গ্রহণ করে) various tricks he leads a life below poverty line (দারিদ্র্যসীমা).

question_text: Write a composition on "Duties of a Student" within 250 words.
answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

question_text: Newspaper is a mirror of the whole world. It provides us with all sorts of news and views. Write a composition on "The Importance of Reading Newspaper".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Water is called life. But it is polluted in many ways. Now, write a paragraph in 250 words on "Water Pollution".
answer_text:
Water Pollution
Water pollution is the contamination (দূষণ) of water. No living being can pass a moment without water. Hence water is an essential element of nature. But polluted water is very harmful as it causes death threatening diseases like diarrhoea, cholera, jaundice, etc. It can be polluted in many ways. Man pollutes water by throwing waste materials into it. Using chemical fertilizers and insecticides (কীটনাশক) farmers pollute water. Rain and floods wash away these chemical fertilizers and insecticides to rivers, canals and ponds and thus water is polluted. Poisonous (বিষাক্ত) chemicals are used in mills and factories. Throwing their waste products into rivers and canals, they pollute water. Steamers, boats and launches throw oil, food and human waste into the water of rivers and canals. and thus make the water polluted. Because of this pollution, fish cannot survive. People also become ill by drinking and bathing in the polluted water. By checking the dumping of factory waste, water pollution can be minimized. We can also purify it by boiling or using purification (বিশুদ্ধকরণ) tablets. So, to keep good health, we must try to prevent water pollution.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby" within 250 words.
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Trees are the most important gift of nature. But cutting down trees affects our environment greatly. Now, write a paragraph in 250 words on "The Bad Impacts of deforestation".
answer_text:
The Bad Impacts of Deforestation
Deforestation means cutting and burning down of forests. There are many causes of deforestation. People are increasing like mice in a barn (গোলাঘরে ইঁদুরের বৃদ্ধির মতো). Their needs and necessities are also increasing. As trees and plants are of great use to them, they cut them down. They use timber to make furniture and firewood for fuel. By burning down forest, they also make living place. But they are not aware of the harmful effects of deforestation. Due to deforestation, carbon dioxide is increasing. And so the weather pattern is being changed. The world is becoming warmer. The heat of the sun is trapped (আটকা পড়া) inside the atmosphere. As a result, the polar ice caps are melting. And this situation will flood huge areas of the globe. As ours is a low-lying region, it may one day go under water. Therefore, effective measures should be taken to prevent deforestation. Tree plantation programme should be introduced. If one cuts down a tree, one should plant two trees. Besides, public awareness should be raised to grow more plants and trees.
[Words : 162]

question_text: Write a composition about 'The Importance of Reading Newspaper.'
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Our National Flag".
answer_text:
Our National Flag (আমাদের জাতীয় পতাকা)
The national flag of Bangladesh is a symbol of pride and identity for the people of the country. It features a deep green background with a large red disc in the centre, representing the rising sun. The color green symbolizes the country's lush vegetation and agricultural heritage, while the red disc represents the bloodshed and sacrifices made during the struggle for independence from Pakistan in 1971. The flag has a rectangular shape with a length to width ratio of 10:6. The size of the national flag is regulated by law, with specifications for the proportions and dimensions of the flag for different occasions and uses. The flag is flown on public and private buildings, during national holidays and events, and on official government vehicles. The flag is also an essential component of the country's diplomatic representation abroad, and it is prominently displayed at Bangladeshi embassies and high commissions worldwide. The national flag is kept half-mast on the occasion of national mourning day and on the 21st February. However, our national flag is not just a piece of cloth, but it represents the identity and dignity of the nation. The flag serves as a unifying force that brings the people of Bangladesh together under a common goal of progress, development, and prosperity. The national flag of Bangladesh is a powerful symbol of the country's past, present, and future, and it inspires a sense of patriotism and national pride in the hearts of its citizens.

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby".

My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A School Magazine".
answer_text:
A School Magazine (বিদ্যালয় সাময়িকী)
A school magazine is an important part of any educational institution. It is a publication that is created by students and teachers alike and showcases the achievements, ideas, and creativity of the school community. A school magazine typically contains a range of content, from news and current events to features on the school's sports teams, clubs, and extracurricular activities. It may also feature interviews with teachers, students, and community members, as well as artwork, poetry, and short stories. In addition to providing an outlet for students' creativity, a school magazine can also help to foster a sense of community within the school. It allows students to learn about and appreciate the diverse talents and interests of their peers, and to celebrate their collective achievements. Publishing a school magazine is a valuable learning experience for students, as it requires collaboration, research, writing, editing, and design skills. Students who participate in the creation of the magazine gain valuable experience in journalism, publishing, and media production, which can be useful for them in their future academic and professional endeavours. Overall, a school magazine is an important part of the school community, providing a forum for students to express themselves, showcase their talents, and celebrate their accomplishments. It is a testament to the creativity, diversity, and academic excellence of the school, and an enduring record of the memories and experiences shared by its students.

question_text: Write a composition on "The Season You Like Most".
answer_text:
The Season I Like Most/Best (The Spring)
Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Each season has its own features. Of the six seasons of Bangla year, I love the spring most. It is the king of seasons. The spring is one of the most delightful seasons in Bangladesh. It is the season of rebirth, rejuvenation and renewal. It starts in the month of Falgun (February/March) and lasts until Baishakh (April). The weather in spring is simply magical. The bitter cold of winter gradually fades away, and the cool breeze brings a pleasant feeling all around. There is no heavy rainfall, no dark cloud, or no scorching heat of summer. The bright sunshine and blue skies enhance the beauty of nature. The spring comes with the message of hope and enjoyment. The trees and plants put on new leaves. The nature wears a charming look. The flowers bloom everywhere, and the trees turn lush green, making the entire country look vibrant and colourful. One of the best things about spring in Bangladesh is the festivals that come along with it. Pohela Falgun, the first day of spring, is celebrated with much enthusiasm and joy. People dress up in bright and colourful clothes, and the streets are decorated with flowers and banners. Basanta Utsav, the festival of colours, is also celebrated during this season. Another reason why I love spring is that it is the perfect season for outdoor activities. The mild weather makes it ideal for outdoor sports, travelling, picnic, etc. In addition, birdwatchers can indulge in their hobby, as some species of migratory birds visit this country during this season. Overall, spring is the season that brings hope, happiness, and a fresh start to everyone. With its mild weather, colourful landscapes, and festive celebrations, it is no wonder that it is one of the most loved seasons in the country.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Environment Pollution" in about 250 words.
answer_text:
Environment Pollution (পরিবেশ দূষণ)
Environment refers to the air, water, land in which people, animals and plants live. So human beings, animals, plants, air, water, soil etc are the main elements of the environment. The natural forces such as storms, cyclones and earth quakes are also a part of this environment. Environmental pollution means polluting the elements of the environment. Nowadays environment pollution is a burning issue. It is a global problem. It has become a tremendous problem also in Bangladesh. The environmentalists of our country express their great apprehension about our future environment and its effects. The people of our country are destroying our valuable forests day by day. The environment of our country is being polluted for want of sufficient forest resource. Unplanned massive industrialization is another cause of environment pollution. Smoke coming out from the mills and factories is polluting air. Smoke coming out from motor vehicles also pollutes air. Again, the waste products of the mills and factories are thrown into water, which causes pollution of water. The insecticides used in the fields of crops also pollute our environment. Environment pollution is gradually and dangerously changing the climate of our country. Many serious diseases are being caused by this. We must be conscious of the matter and try to get rid of this problem soon. The government should take all possible steps in order to improve this condition.

question_text: Write a composition on "A Journey You have Recently Made."
answer_text:
A Journey by boat I Enjoyed/A Journey by boat
A journey by boat can be a tranquil and peaceful experience, where one can enjoy the serene beauty of nature and the rhythmic flow of water. I recently had the opportunity to enjoy a boat trip and it was an experience that I will never forget. It was an autumn vacation. I enjoyed a journey by boat from Mymensingh to Jamalpur along the river Brahmaputra. The journey started early in the morning when we boarded a wooden boat. The boat was not very big, but it was comfortable and had enough space for all of us. We were a group of eight people, including two boatmen. As we set off, the sun was just rising, and the sky was filled with hues of orange and red. The weather was calm, and we could see the reflection of the sky on the surface of the river. As we left the din and bustle of the town behind, the riverine Bangladesh greeted us with its vast water stretching as far as the eyes could see. It reminded us of the past trading activities through riverways. We passed by small villages on the banks of the river, and we saw people going about their daily lives. Some were fishing, others were bathing or washing their clothes. The boat journey took us through different waterways, including canals and streams, where we saw a variety of birdlife. We saw herons, kingfishers, and many other species of birds. The scenery was stunning, with green fields and trees lining the banks of the waterways. At about 10 a.m, we stopped at a small village along the riverside. We had the chance to explore the village and interact with the locals. They were very friendly and hospitable. We bought some snacks for breakfast. Back on the boat, we enjoyed the traditional snacks and tea while taking in the sights and sounds of the river. One of the highlights of the journey was when we stopped at a village to take our lunch. We saw there how the locals make traditional pottery. The potters skillfully shaped the clay into different objects, such as pots, cups, and plates. We even had the opportunity to try our hand at making some pottery ourselves, which was a lot of fun. The journey lasted for several hours, and we enjoyed every moment of it. It was a great way to experience the natural beauty of our country and learn more about the local culture. I would highly recommend a boat journey to anyone who loves nature and adventure. However, a boat journey is a fantastic experience that I will never forget. It offers a unique perspective on the country's natural beauty and cultural heritage. I hope to have the opportunity to do it again someday.

question_text: Write a paragraph on 'The Life of a Farmer' in about 200 words.
answer_text:
The Life of a Farmer/A Farmer (একজন কৃষকের জীবন/একজন কৃষক)
The person who works in the farm lands for growing various agricultural products is called a farmer. Usually he lives in a village. He is a very important and useful person in the country. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. He is called the father of food production. But they are heavily devaluated. He gets up from bed early in the morning and takes a pair of bullocks and plough to cultivate his land. He works all day long in his land. In Bangladesh, farmers lead a very miserable life. If he can produce good crops, his face beams with joy. On the contrary, if he fails to grow, his sorrows know no bounds. Most farmers of our country live under poverty level. They live from hand to mouth. Bangladesh is mainly an agricultural country. Her prosperity depends on the development of agriculture. That is why, I cannot think of her without a farmer. Therefore, the farmer's prevalent condition ought to be upgraded to help his life reach a standard level.

question_text: Write a composition on 'Your Favourite Game' in about 250 words.
answer_text:
My Favourite Game/ The Game I Like Most
All games are not equally amusing and interesting to us. Among the games I have a great fascination for football which is a popular game all over the world. It is full of thrill for both the players and spectators. It is an excellent form of exercise that makes the players strong and stout. These are the reason for which I like football more than all other games. The game is played between two teams each consisting of eleven players. Of them there is a goalkeeper who prevents the ball from crossing the goalline. There are two full backs standing at a little distance from the goal posts. There are three half backs in a line midway between the forwards and backs who act both as defenders and offenders. There are five other players who play in the forward line. They try to push the ball through the goal posts. The whole game is divided into two equal halves with an interval of fifteen minutes. At the end of the first half each team changes its side. The game is generally played for ninety minutes. In the field the referee is the supreme authority to conduct the game. His decision is final. Two lines men assist him to run the game smoothly and properly. During the play no player except the goalkeeper can touch the ball with hands. No player in the game can make any foul, In case of making any foul the referee can send any player off the field. The victory goes to the team that can score more goals than the other. The game of football teaches us the principle of obedience to rules. It fosters the spirit of love, discipline and co-operation among the players. It develops team spirit and sportsmanship in the players. There is nothing which is an unmixed blessing. Too much involvement in the game often makes students apathetic towards their studies. Rivalry in the play often leads to quarrell among the supporters in the gallery and spoils the thrill and joy of the game. Sometimes it goes to touch extent that the whole ground turns into a battle field. But inspite of having some negative sides, football is the most popular and exciting game in the world.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "Our National Flag".
answer_text:
Our National Flag (আমাদের জাতীয় পতাকা)
The national flag of Bangladesh is a symbol of pride and identity for the people of the country. It features a deep green background with a large red disc in the centre, representing the rising sun. The color green symbolizes the country's lush vegetation and agricultural heritage, while the red disc represents the bloodshed and sacrifices made during the struggle for independence from Pakistan in 1971. The flag has a rectangular shape with a length to width ratio of 10:6. The size of the national flag is regulated by law, with specifications for the proportions and dimensions of the flag for different occasions and uses. The flag is flown on public and private buildings, during national holidays and events, and on official government vehicles. The flag is also an essential component of the country's diplomatic representation abroad, and it is prominently displayed at Bangladeshi embassies and high commissions worldwide. The national flag is kept half-mast on the occasion of national mourning day and on the 21st February. However, our national flag is not just a piece of cloth, but it represents the identity and dignity of the nation. The flag serves as a unifying force that brings the people of Bangladesh together under a common goal of progress, development, and prosperity. The national flag of Bangladesh is a powerful symbol of the country's past, present, and future, and it inspires a sense of patriotism and national pride in the hearts of its citizens.

question_text: Suppose, you are Sohan/Sohana of 9, Mymensingh Road, Dhaka-1000. Recently you have enjoyed a picnic. Your friend Nahid/Nahida of 71/C, Broad Lane, Khulna wants to know about the picnic. Now, write a letter to your friend telling him/her how you have enjoyed the picnic.
answer_text:
9, Mymensingh Road,
Dhaka-1000
20 March 2025
Dear Nahid,
I received your letter on the 10th instant. I am sorry for not replying to it earlier. In your letter you wanted to know about the picnic that I had made with my friends at a place of historical importance. Here I am giving you a description of the picnic. I along with my friends made a plan to visit Sonargaon. On February 20, we started from Dhaka by bus at 8 a.m. We reached the spot at 10 a.m. We took necessary food and drinks with us. Reaching there at first we took our breakfast and then started to see the ancient places. To memorise the moment I took some photos. As I have the experience about the place I guided my friends to show the relics. We spent the whole day at the site of the picnic and enjoyed ourselves. After sunset we came back to Dhaka by bus. Actually, we spent a happy moment and its impression (ধারণা) will be everlasting on my mind. No more today. Please write to me as early as possible.
With best regards,
Sohan

question_text: Write a composition on "Importance of Reading Newspapers".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Suppose, one day you visited a tea stall in your locality. You stayed there for about an hour and had some experiences about the stall. Now, write a paragraph on "A Tea Stall".
answer_text:
A Tea Stall (চায়ের দোকান)
A tea stall is an ever-present and essential part of daily life. This humble roadside establishment is where people gather to catch up with friends, engage in discussions, and take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The tea stall is typically a simple structure, consisting of a few wooden benches or plastic chairs, a small counter, and a large saucepan/cauldron of boiling water and a saucepan of milk for making tea. Customers can enjoy a hot cup of tea with a variety of snacks like biscuits, samosas, or singaras. The tea stall is a great equalizer, where people from all avenues of life come together to share a moment of relaxation. It is not uncommon to see students, office workers, shopkeepers, and even rickshaw pullers taking a break at the tea stall. The atmosphere is usually lively, with the sound of clinking glasses and chatter filling the air. In the evening, tea stalls transform into social hubs, where people gather to discuss politics, sports, and current affairs. A tea stall is not just a place to drink tea, it is a cultural phenomenon that reflects the warmth and hospitality of the people of our country. For many, a tea stall is a daily ritual, a place to unwind, and a respite from the chaos of the outside world. Whether you are a local or a tourist, a visit to a tea stall is a must-do experience that will leave you with a newfound appreciation for the simple pleasures of life.

question_text: Suppose, you are Nabil/Nabila, a student of class 9 of Balaka Model High School, Rajshahi. Students of your school feel the necessity of opening a canteen in the school campus. Now, write an application to your Head Teacher, on behalf of the students of the whole school, praying for opening a canteen in the school campus.
answer_text:
13 March 2025
The Headmaster
Jamalpur Zilla School, Jamalpur
Subject : Request for setting up a canteen.
Dear Sir,
We, the students of your renowned school, have the honour to draw your kind attention to the fact that there is no canteen in our school. We have to stay for a long time in the school. Passing this long period without tiffin is very difficult. If the students can't have some snacks in the tiffin period, they get feeble and consequently can't concentrate on lesson. Besides, it also may cause vearious stomach diseases like gastic and ulcer. For want of a canteen many students take unhyegenic food from road-side which is also very harmful to health. Most often the students get sick taking food from outside the school. As morning shift in our school starts at 7:00 am, many students have to come to school without breakfast. If there was a canteen in the school, they could have some food from there. We, therefore, pray and hope that you would take initiative to set up a canteen in our school as soon as possible and thus mitigate the above mentioned problem.
Sincerely yours
Shovo
On behalf of the pupils of your school
