question_text: Suppose, as a student you are sincere in study and alongside your academic study, you read newspapers regularly. Now, write a composition on "The Importance of Reading Newspapers".
answer_text:
Importance of Reading Newspaper
Newspapers are an important part of our daily lives. They are the primary source of information for most people, providing news and updates from around the world. Reading newspapers is not only informative but also essential for various reasons. It is a habit that should be inculcated in children at an early age. Firstly, reading newspapers helps individuals to keep themselves updated with the latest news and current affairs from around the world. The news on various topics such as politics, sports, business, entertainment, etc. can be accessed in newspapers. One can learn about new laws, policies, and events that are taking place in their own country and abroad. This information is essential as it helps individuals to make informed decisions in their daily lives. Secondly, reading newspapers can enhance an individual's vocabulary and reading skills. Newspapers are written in different styles, and one can learn different writing styles and techniques by reading them. It can also help in improving reading speed and comprehension skills. Thirdly, reading newspapers helps individuals to develop critical thinking skills. As they read different news articles, they can analyze and form opinions on various topics. It also helps in developing analytical skills and broadening an individual's perspective on different issues. Fourthly, reading newspapers can be a source of entertainment for some people. Apart from news, newspapers also provide various columns, puzzles, and games that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. In a nutshell, reading newspapers is an essential habit that individuals should develop. It provides a lot of information that helps in making informed decisions and improving knowledge. Moreover, it also helps in developing various skills such as critical thinking, analytical skills, and vocabulary.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Winter Morning".
answer_text:
A Winter Morning (একটি শীতের সকাল)
A winter morning is a truly unique experience. Unlike other seasons, when the morning air is often warm and humid, a winter morning brings with it a crisp, refreshing chill that can invigorate the senses. The sun, still low in the sky, casts a warm golden glow over the landscape, and the early morning mist adds a dreamy quality to the scenery. The leaves on the trees and the grass on the ground are covered in dew, sparkling like diamonds in the soft light. As the sun begins to rise, people emerge from their homes, bundled up in warm clothes, ready to start their day. In the rural areas, farmers start their day early, heading out to tend to their crops and livestock, while others set out to collect firewood or fetch water from nearby sources. Children can be seen playing outside, their breath visible in the cold air as they run around. In the cities, life is a bit more fast-paced, but the chill in the air is still noticeable. People hurry to work or school, bundled up in warm clothes. Vendors selling hot tea, pithas, and other snacks can be found on street corners, providing some warmth and comfort to passerby. Shopkeepers open their stores, setting out warm clothes, blankets, and heaters for sale. Despite the cold weather, there is a sense of joy and excitement in the air, as people enjoy different types of pithas, date juice, etc. However, not everyone enjoys the winter morning. The poor suffer the most due to lack of proper shelter and warm clothes. Overall, a winter morning in Bangladesh is a mixed bag of emotions. It is a beautiful and serene time for some, while it brings about suffering and hardship for others.

question_text: Send a letter of advice to your younger brother by using his email address to be regular in his studies.

To : <zihad@yahoo.com>
Subject : To be regular in studies
Dear Zihad,
Best wishes to you. Hope you are quite well. I have learnt from a reliable source that you have recently become a bit inattentive to your studies. It is also reported that you spend so much time in loitering with some bad friends. What can be more distressing to me than this? You should know that life is not a bed of roses. It is a constant struggle against all odds. The proverb goes "As you sow, so you reap." This is the seed time of your life. You will get harvest in proportion to the care you take of your land. Proper education and formation of character can only lead you to succeed in life. There is no alternative to it. I would henceforth want to hear that you have shunned all your summer friends and have become cautious as to your future. You know, father will be greatly shocked if he hears it. However, I hope you would follow my advice and act accordingly. No more today. Send a reply soon. I shall meet you shortly. With best affection and love.
Your brother,
Jony

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Favourite Hobby".
answer_text:
My Favourite Hobby/My Hobby/Playing Guitar as My Hobby
A hobby is an activity that someone does for enjoyment or pleasure during their free time. It is usually an activity that is not related to work or other obligations. Hobbies can include anything from sports, music, arts and crafts, cooking, gardening, and more. Different people have different types of tastes, so they have different hobbies. My favourite hobby is playing guitar. It is a great way for me to express myself creatively. It also helps me relax and unwind after a long day. When I first started playing guitar, it was a bit overwhelming. There were so many cords to learn and my fingers would often hurt from pressing down on the strings. But with practice and patience, I soon began to see progress. One of the things I love about playing guitar is the versatility of the instrument. I can play anything from rock to blues to folk music, and it always feels great to learn a new song. Another thing that makes playing guitar so enjoyable is the social aspect of it. I love playing with other musicians and jamming out with friends. It is a great way to connect with others and share a love for music. Playing guitar has also taught me important lessons about discipline and perseverance. It takes time and effort to get better at anything, and the same is true for guitar. But every time I practice, I am improving and getting closer to my goals. In summary, playing guitar is my favourite hobby because it allows me to express myself creatively, relax and unwind, learn new songs, connect with others, and develop important life skills.

question_text: Write a paragraph in 250 words on Our National Flag.
answer_text:
Our National Flag (আমাদের জাতীয় পতাকা)
The national flag of Bangladesh is a symbol of pride and identity for the people of the country. It features a deep green background with a large red disc in the centre, representing the rising sun. The color green symbolizes the country's lush vegetation and agricultural heritage, while the red disc represents the bloodshed and sacrifices made during the struggle for independence from Pakistan in 1971. The flag has a rectangular shape with a length to width ratio of 10:6. The size of the national flag is regulated by law, with specifications for the proportions and dimensions of the flag for different occasions and uses. The flag is flown on public and private buildings, during national holidays and events, and on official government vehicles. The flag is also an essential component of the country's diplomatic representation abroad, and it is prominently displayed at Bangladeshi embassies and high commissions worldwide. The national flag is kept half-mast on the occasion of national mourning day and on the 21st February. However, our national flag is not just a piece of cloth, but it represents the identity and dignity of the nation. The flag serves as a unifying force that brings the people of Bangladesh together under a common goal of progress, development, and prosperity. The national flag of Bangladesh is a powerful symbol of the country's past, present, and future, and it inspires a sense of patriotism and national pride in the hearts of its citizens.

question_text: Suppose, you are Sayem/Samia. You and your parents went to Chattogram by train a few days ago. You wish to share this new experience with your friend Abrar/Anika. Now, write a letter to your friend sharing the experience of the train journey that you made.
answer_text:
3 Srish Das Lane,
Sutrapur, Dhaka
19 February 2025
Dear Anika,
Your letter of the 18th instant is to hand. I am very glad to know from your letter that you are hale and hearty. Anyway, today I'll share an experience of a thrilling train journey with you that I underwent accompanying my parents few days ago. We went to Chattogram by train to visit my uncle living there. On the appointed day we went to the Kamalapur Railway Station at 7:00 am. The train left the station duely. I sat on my seat. I felt thrilled (রোমাঞ্চিত) and excited when the train sped up and everything seemed to me to be moving and jolting. Not only this, it seemed to me that everything was going on along with the train. It made me much more excited and thrilled. At last, our train reached the destination (গন্তব্য) at 2:00 pm. I hired a porter to carry my luggage and gave him some wages. And that was my first train journey in my life. No more today. More when we shall meet each other. Convey my best regards to your parents and love to the youngers.
Yours ever,
Samia

question_text: Write a composition on The Season You Like Most.
answer_text:
The Season I Like Most/Best (The Spring)
Bangladesh is a land of six seasons. Each season has its own features. Of the six seasons of Bangla year, I love the spring most. It is the king of seasons. The spring is one of the most delightful seasons in Bangladesh. It is the season of rebirth, rejuvenation and renewal. It starts in the month of Falgun (February/March) and lasts until Baishakh (April). The weather in spring is simply magical. The bitter cold of winter gradually fades away, and the cool breeze brings a pleasant feeling all around. There is no heavy rainfall, no dark cloud, or no scorching heat of summer. The bright sunshine and blue skies enhance the beauty of nature. The spring comes with the message of hope and enjoyment. The trees and plants put on new leaves. The nature wears a charming look. The flowers bloom everywhere, and the trees turn lush green, making the entire country look vibrant and colourful. One of the best things about spring in Bangladesh is the festivals that come along with it. Pohela Falgun, the first day of spring, is celebrated with much enthusiasm and joy. People dress up in bright and colourful clothes, and the streets are decorated with flowers and banners. Basanta Utsav, the festival of colours, is also celebrated during this season. Another reason why I love spring is that it is the perfect season for outdoor activities. The mild weather makes it ideal for outdoor sports, travelling, picnic, etc. In addition, birdwatchers can indulge in their hobby, as some species of migratory birds visit this country during this season. Overall, spring is the season that brings hope, happiness, and a fresh start to everyone. With its mild weather, colourful landscapes, and festive celebrations, it is no wonder that it is one of the most loved seasons in the country.

question_text: Write a paragraph on 'Deforestation'.
answer_text:
The Bad Impacts of Deforestation
Deforestation means cutting and burning down of forests. There are many causes of deforestation. People are increasing like mice in a barn (গোলাঘরে ইঁদুরের বৃদ্ধির মতো). Their needs and necessities are also increasing. As trees and plants are of great use to them, they cut them down. They use timber to make furniture and firewood for fuel. By burning down forest, they also make living place. But they are not aware of the harmful effects of deforestation. Due to deforestation, carbon dioxide is increasing. And so the weather pattern is being changed. The world is becoming warmer. The heat of the sun is trapped (আটকা পড়া) inside the atmosphere. As a result, the polar ice caps are melting. And this situation will flood huge areas of the globe. As ours is a low-lying region, it may one day go under water. Therefore, effective measures should be taken to prevent deforestation. Tree plantation programme should be introduced. If one cuts down a tree, one should plant two trees. Besides, public awareness should be raised to grow more plants and trees.
[Words : 162]

question_text: Suppose, you are Samin/Samina living at Rupnagar, Narayangonj. You have a friend named Joy/Joya living at Sonapur, Chattogram. He/She does not read the newspaper daily. Now, write an email to him/her describing the importance of reading newspaper.
answer_text:
To : joyarahman@gmail.com
Subject : Importance of reading newspaper
Dear Joya,
Take my love and affection. Hope, you are hale and hearty by the grace of almighty Allah. I'm also well by His blessings. From your last letter I have come to know that you are interested to know about the benefits of reading newspaper. Actually newspaper is the storehouse of knowledge. By reading newspaper, you can know political, economic, social, cultural and meteorological affairs of home and abroad. You can know current affairs of the whole world. You can widen your outlook and orientation by going through newspaper. In fact, you can enter every branch of knowledge only by reading newspaper.
That's all today. Write to me whenever you can manage time. Take care of your health.
Yours ever,
Samina

question_text: Write a Composition on "Service Rendered by The Students To Build Up Our Nation."
answer_text:
Students and Social Service
As students are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should render social services during leisure or long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can organize social service squads in their respective institutions to work in different areas. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot in removing illiteracy by educating the people in a proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, rules of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern scientific methods of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. In critical positions of the country, students must lead the country. As the students can nurse the wounded in the field of war, they can save life of many soldiers. Bangladesh faces natural calamities every year. During these disasters, the students can help the distressed people. Students must keep themselves ready to sacrifice their supreme pleasure at the time of danger. Then and only then he or she will be regarded as the crown of the deprived people because, they are the selfless sections of the society. Their services are regarded as noble deeds. So, they must take active part in these noble deeds.

question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Winter Morning".
answer_text:
A Winter Morning (একটি শীতের সকাল)
A winter morning is a truly unique experience. Unlike other seasons, when the morning air is often warm and humid, a winter morning brings with it a crisp, refreshing chill that can invigorate the senses. The sun, still low in the sky, casts a warm golden glow over the landscape, and the early morning mist adds a dreamy quality to the scenery. The leaves on the trees and the grass on the ground are covered in dew, sparkling like diamonds in the soft light. As the sun begins to rise, people emerge from their homes, bundled up in warm clothes, ready to start their day. In the rural areas, farmers start their day early, heading out to tend to their crops and livestock, while others set out to collect firewood or fetch water from nearby sources. Children can be seen playing outside, their breath visible in the cold air as they run around. In the cities, life is a bit more fast-paced, but the chill in the air is still noticeable. People hurry to work or school, bundled up in warm clothes. Vendors selling hot tea, pithas, and other snacks can be found on street corners, providing some warmth and comfort to passerby. Shopkeepers open their stores, setting out warm clothes, blankets, and heaters for sale. Despite the cold weather, there is a sense of joy and excitement in the air, as people enjoy different types of pithas, date juice, etc. However, not everyone enjoys the winter morning. The poor suffer the most due to lack of proper shelter and warm clothes. Overall, a winter morning in Bangladesh is a mixed bag of emotions. It is a beautiful and serene time for some, while it brings about suffering and hardship for others.

question_text: Suppose, you are Mollick/Mollicka. You have recently visited a new place with some of your friends and family members. Now, write a letter to your friend Asif/Asifa who lives in another city, describing your experience of the visit.
answer_text:
Shyamnagar, Satkhira
February 2025
My dear Asifa,
Take my heartest (আন্তরিক) love at first. You haven't written to me for about two months. However, this writing is to inform you of a pleasing tour that I along with some of my friends and family members made last week. The tour was to grand city, Dhaka. We enjoyed the place very much. Now I would like to share my feelings and experience with you. You know one of my brothers lives in the city of Dhaka. He had been requesting me to go to Dhaka to visit the city. So last week I decided to go to Dhaka. We went to Dhaka by bus and my brother received me at the Gabtali Bus Terminal. From the next day we started visiting different places in Dhaka city with my brother. He was in fact our guide. He took us to many important places in the city. First of all, we visited the Naitonal Memorial at Savar. Then I was astonished (বিস্মিত হওয়া) visiting the 'Jatya Sangsad Bhaban' because of its architectural beauty and vast compound. In the afternoon we visited National Shaheed Minar and National Museum. The next day we went to the National Zoo at Mirpur, Lalbag Fort and some other places. We also visited newly built flyover at different places in Dhaka. We also visited some historical places in Old Dhaka such as Star Mosque, Ahsan Monjil, Lalbag Fort, Hosni Dalan etc. Visiting these places we not only enjoyed much but also gathered a lot of experience. This tour to Dhaka will remain ever fresh in my mind. No more today. Best regards (শ্রদ্ধা) to your parents and also love to the youngers.
Yours ever,
Mollicka

question_text: Write a composition on "Your Future Plan of Life".
answer_text:
My Aim in Life/ My Future Plan of Life/ The Profession you like to take up in Future
Human being is the best creation of God. He is a rational animal. Every man, who lives in the society, has an aim in life. Without it none can make progress. The man, who has no aim in life, is like a ship without a rudder. But a fixed aim helps a man to shine in life. So, it is essential for every man. Planning for future is essential for an individual life. So, a man should choose an aim for future life. But different persons have different tastes and aims. There are many professions in the world. So, it is difficult to choose a correct one. Some want to earn money, some want to earn fame, some want to serve the people. I want neither money nor fame. I want to serve the people of my locality. With this noble idea I have chosen to be a doctor. Bangladesh is a very poor country. The living standard (জীবনমান) of the people of our country is very low. They are not aware of the rules of health. They suffer from many diseases. They are illiterate about what kind of food is essential for them. I have seen how the people of my village suffer from diseases every year and die without treatment and medical help. The people of our country suffer from superstition and many of them fall into this trap. So, I have decided to become a doctor and serve my poor and illiterate villagers. After passing the HSC examination in science group, I shall get myself admitted into MBBS course in Dhaka Medical College or others. Obtaining the highest degree in medical science, I shall go to my native village to serve the people of my locality. I shall set up a charitable dispensary in our village market. I shall treat the poor patients without fees. Medical profession is the noblest of all professions. It brings money and love of man. To serve the distressed humanity is to serve God. I want to live in the memory of mass people even after my death. So, I have decided to become a doctor. To become successful in life, every man should choose the profession carefully. I think my choice is the best one for my life and for the lives of villagers.

question_text: Write a Paragraph on Tree Plantation in about 250 words.
answer_text:
Tree Plantation/ Importance of Trees
Tree plantation means planting more trees and plants. The purpose of tree plantation is to save the endangered (বিপদগ্রস্ত করা) environment and to beautify our life. Tree plantation is very important because it serves many useful purposes. We get flowers, fruits, fuel and timber from trees. Trees make air fresh and improve the environment. They save us from natural calamities like drought, storms, floods, etc. They increase the beauty of nature. They give us oxygen and take up carbon dioxide and thus maintain ecological (বাস্তুসংস্থানগত) balance. In absence of trees, the country will turn into a desert. So trees are a valuable asset for our existence. Among the seasons, rainy season is the best time for tree plantation. We can plant trees around our dwelling places and in open places. Moreover, trees can be planted by the roads, rivers, canals and playing fields. Awareness should be raised and campaign should be launched to motivate people for tree plantation. Thus we can make the tree plantation programme a success.
[Words : 164]

question_text: Write a composition on 'The Duties of a Student'.
answer_text:
Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.

question_text: Suppose, you are Habib/Habiba of Dhaka. You have a friend named Neel/Nila who lives in Jamalpur. Your elder sister's wedding ceremony is going to be held next week. Now, write an email to your friend inviting him/her to attend the wedding ceremony.
answer_text:
To : <neel@gmail.com>
Subject : Request to attend the marriage ceremony
My dear Neel,
The marriage ceremony of my elder sister, Mahmuda, is going to be held on Friday, the 30th instant. So I shall be very glad to have you in our midst on this happy occasion. My parents also expect you in our midst very much. The bridegroom's party will reach our house at 7:00 p.m. on the 30th. I should, therefore, request you to come to our house at least a day before the said party reaches our house. We shall be very happy to have you with us and we shall be very sorry if you fail to turn up at the right time. More when we shall meet together. I am eagerly awaiting your arrival in time.
Thanking you,
Habib

question_text: Write a composition on 'Recent Floods in Bangladesh'.
answer_text:
Recent Floods in Bangladesh
Flood is a natural calamity. Almost every year it occurs in Bangladesh. Then our miseries know no bounds. It causes untold sufferings to lives. Lives are lost also, valuable riches and resources are destroyed, crops are damaged, domestic animals are washed away, trees and plants are uprooted, roads and high ways are damaged. In fact, flood causes indescribable loss to lives and properties. Now a question can be raised here why flood occurs in our country. In fact, Bangladesh is a low lying country. Besides, environment pollution severely occurs here. On the contrary, our neighbouring country India opens Farakka barage during the rainy season and flood water enters in our country. However, in 2004 flood occurred in Bangladesh. Almost every district went under water. Then human miseries knew no bounds. Relief materials were provided to the flood affected people but those were very much scanty. Besides, some relief materials were also stolen. In 2007 flood also occurred in our country. This flood also caused untold miseries to the affected people. But people were not deprived of relief goods and materials. Because of the fact that there is no political government at that time, the caretaker government strictly distributed relief materials among the affected people. No mismanagement and misappropriation of relief goods has not been heard. The affected people were also heavily pleased by having sufficient relief goods. It's really a matter of great credit. This government has also taken decision to provide the flood affected people with permanent solution, that is, those who are affected by flood are supposed to be rehabilitated. It's a good decision. However, as flood occurs in our country, precautionary steps should be taken to minimise losses caused by it. Otherwise hopes and aspirations will be shattered by the rocks of reality.

Nutun Para, Natore
May 2025
My dear Tasnia,
Take my love from the core of my heart. I hope, you are all right. I am also well. You wanted to know about the prize giving ceremony of our school. Now, I am writing to you about it. Last Sunday, 20 May was the annual prize giving ceremony for academic result and sports. The function was very colourful. It was held on our school playground. In order to celebrate the day the authority (কর্তৃপক্ষ) concerned decorated the school premises (প্রাঙ্গণ) with colourful flags and festoons. The function began with the reciting from the holy Quran. The youth and sports minister was invited as the chief guest. I got a prize for better result in the Test Examination. Many students got prizes. After finishing the prize giving ceremony the drama of William Shakespeare 'As You Like It' was staged. We enjoyed it much. No more today. Convey my compliments to your parents and love to the youngers.
Yours loving,

Duties of a Student
Students are the future citizens of the country. So, it is their main duty to acquire knowledge. As they are the future leaders, they need to have a sound education which will enable them to do good to the nation. They should also render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. The students have youthful vigour and consequently energy, warmth and inspiration. Students should devote themselves to the service of the society. They can also organize welfare centers of humanitarian (মানবকল্যাণমূলক) services among the poor and needy. The students can do a lot to remove illiteracy by educating the people in the proper way. They may conduct night schools and instruct the ignorant about their homeland's history, moral values, evils of superstition, need of co-operation, laws of health and social life, duties as citizens etc. Bangladesh is an agricultural country. But the farmers are not aware of the modern system of cultivation. The students can convince the people of the utility of modern methods of cultivation. They can motivate people to grow more food. An ideal student must keep himself ready to sacrifice his supreme pleasure at the time of need. They must make a proper utilization of their time, take good care of their health, develop their mental faculty by doing co-curricular activities, practising honesty, truthfulness, piety and kindness in every step of their life.
